warmup: 1. 给下列电影名字选择对应的图片 / Match the movies with their posters. Six romantic-film titles with pinyin are listed for students to match against six lettered posters (A–F: A=Roman Holiday, B=When a Man Loves a Woman, C=Titanic, D=Sleepless in Seattle, E=Notting Hill, F=Romeo+Juliet): ①《西雅图未眠夜》(Xīyǎtú Wèi Mián Yè) Sleepless in Seattle; ②《诺丁山》(Nuòdīngshān) Notting Hill; ③《当男人爱上女人》(Dāng Nánrén Àishang Nǚrén) When a Man Loves a Woman; ④《罗马假日》(Luómǎ Jiàrì) Roman Holiday; ⑤《罗密欧与朱丽叶》(Luómǐ'ōu Yǔ Zhūlìyè) Romeo and Juliet; ⑥《泰坦尼克号》(Tàitǎnníkè Hào) Titanic.

2. 你理想中的男/女朋友是什么样的？为什么？ / What is your ideal boyfriend/girlfriend like? Why? A checkbox questionnaire table lets students describe an ideal partner across six categories: 身高 height (<160cm, 160-170cm, 170-180cm, >180cm); 体重 weight (<50kg, 50-60kg, 60-70kg, >70kg); 头发 hair (长发 long, 短发 short, 直发 straight, 卷发 juǎnfà curly); 眼睛 eyes (大眼睛 big, 小眼睛 small, 单眼皮 dān yǎnpí single eyelid, 双眼皮 double eyelid); 性格 xìnggé character (幽默 yōumò humorous, 可爱 cute, 安静 quiet, 认真 serious/conscientious); 爱好 hobbies (运动 sports, 看电影 movies, 音乐 music, 做菜 cooking).

texts.label: 课文1
texts.heading_zh: 孙月和王静聊王静的男朋友
texts.heading_en: Sun Yue and Wang Jing Talk About Wang Jing's Boyfriend

lines.speaker: 孙月
lines.zh: 听说你男朋友李进跟你是一个学校的，是你同学吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ nánpéngyou Lǐ Jìn gēn nǐ shì yí ge xuéxiào de, shì nǐ tóngxué ma?
lines.en: I heard your boyfriend Li Jin is from the same school as you — is he your classmate?

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 是的，他学的是新闻，我学的是法律，我和他不是一个班。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, tā xué de shì xīnwén, wǒ xué de shì fǎlǜ, wǒ hé tā bú shì yí ge bān.
lines.en: Yes, he studies journalism and I study law — we're not in the same class.

lines.speaker: 孙月
lines.zh: 那你们俩是怎么认识的？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐmen liǎ shì zěnme rènshi de?
lines.en: So how did the two of you meet?

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 我们是在一次足球比赛中认识的。我们班跟他们班比赛，他一个人踢进两个球，我对他印象很深，后来就慢慢熟悉了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen shì zài yí cì zúqiú bǐsài zhōng rènshi de. Wǒmen bān gēn tāmen bān bǐsài, tā yí ge rén tījìn liǎng ge qiú, wǒ duì tā yìnxiàng hěn shēn, hòulái jiù mànmàn shúxi le.
lines.en: We met during a soccer match. Our class played against his class, and he scored two goals by himself — it made a deep impression on me, and later we gradually got to know each other well.

lines.speaker: 孙月
lines.zh: 你为什么喜欢他？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan tā?
lines.en: Why do you like him?

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 他不仅足球踢得好，性格也不错。
lines.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn zúqiú tī de hǎo, xìnggé yě búcuò.
lines.en: Not only does he play soccer well, his personality is great too.

texts.label: 课文2
texts.heading_zh: 王静跟李老师聊她要结婚的事情
texts.heading_en: Wang Jing Talks with Teacher Li About Getting Married

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 李老师，我下个月5号就要结婚了。
lines.pinyin: Lǐ lǎoshī, wǒ xià ge yuè wǔ hào jiù yào jié hūn le.
lines.en: Teacher Li, I'm getting married on the 5th of next month.

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.zh: 你是在开玩笑吧？你们不是才认识一个月？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shì zài kāi wánxiào ba? Nǐmen bú shì cái rènshi yí ge yuè?
lines.en: Are you kidding? Haven't you only known each other for a month?

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 虽然我们认识的时间不长，但我从来没这么快乐过。
lines.pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen rènshi de shíjiān bù cháng, dàn wǒ cónglái méi zhème kuàilèguo.
lines.en: Although we haven't known each other long, I've never been this happy before.

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.zh: 两个人在一起，最好能有共同的兴趣和爱好。
lines.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén zài yìqǐ, zuìhǎo néng yǒu gòngtóng de xìngqù hé àihào.
lines.en: When two people are together, it's best if they have common interests and hobbies.

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 我们有很多共同的爱好，经常一起打球、唱歌、做菜。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu hěn duō gòngtóng de àihào, jīngcháng yìqǐ dǎ qiú, chàng gē, zuò cài.
lines.en: We have a lot of hobbies in common — we often play ball games, sing, and cook together.

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.zh: 看来你真的找到适合你的人了。祝你们幸福！
lines.pinyin: Kànlái nǐ zhēn de zhǎodào shìhé nǐ de rén le. Zhù nǐmen xìngfú!
lines.en: It looks like you've really found the right person for you. Wishing you happiness!

texts.label: 课文3
texts.heading_zh: 高老师和李老师聊结婚后的生活
texts.heading_en: Teacher Gao and Teacher Li Talk About Life After Marriage

lines.speaker: 高老师
lines.zh: 听说您跟妻子结婚快二十年了？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nín gēn qīzi jié hūn kuài èrshí nián le?
lines.en: I heard you and your wife have been married almost twenty years?

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.zh: 到6月9号，我们就结婚二十年了。这么多年，我们的生活一直挺幸福的。
lines.pinyin: Dào liùyuè jiǔ hào, wǒmen jiù jié hūn èrshí nián le. Zhème duō nián, wǒmen de shēnghuó yìzhí tǐng xìngfú de.
lines.en: By June 9th, we'll have been married twenty years. All these years, our life together has been quite happy.

lines.speaker: 高老师
lines.zh: 我和丈夫刚结婚的时候，每天都觉得很新鲜，在一起有说不完的话。但是现在……
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hé zhàngfu gāng jié hūn de shíhou, měi tiān dōu juéde hěn xīnxiān, zài yìqǐ yǒu shuō bu wán de huà. Dànshì xiànzài……
lines.en: When my husband and I had just gotten married, every day felt fresh and exciting, and we had endless things to talk about together. But now……

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.zh: 两个人共同生活，只有浪漫和新鲜感是不够的。
lines.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén gòngtóng shēnghuó, zhǐ yǒu làngmàn hé xīnxiāngǎn shì bú gòu de.
lines.en: When two people live together, romance and novelty alone aren't enough.

lines.speaker: 高老师
lines.zh: 您说的对！我现在每天看到的都是他的缺点。
lines.pinyin: Nín shuō de duì! Wǒ xiànzài měi tiān kàndào de dōu shì tā de quēdiǎn.
lines.en: You're right! Now all I see every day are his shortcomings.

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.zh: 两个人在一起时间长了，就会有很多问题。只有接受了他的缺点，你们才能更好地一起生活。
lines.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén zài yìqǐ shíjiān cháng le, jiù huì yǒu hěn duō wèntí. Zhǐyǒu jiēshòule tā de quēdiǎn, nǐmen cái néng gèng hǎo de yìqǐ shēnghuó.
lines.en: When two people have been together a long time, many problems arise. Only by accepting his shortcomings can you two live together better.

lines.zh: 很多女孩子羡慕浪漫的爱情。
lines.pinyin: Hěn duō nǚháizi xiànmù làngmàn de àiqíng.
lines.en: Many girls admire romantic love.

lines.zh: 那什么是浪漫呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà shénme shì làngmàn ne?
lines.en: So what exactly is romance?

lines.zh: 年轻人说：浪漫是她想要月亮时，你不会给她星星；
lines.pinyin: Niánqīng rén shuō: Làngmàn shì tā xiǎng yào yuèliang shí, nǐ bú huì gěi tā xīngxing;
lines.en: Young people say: romance is that when she wants the moon, you won't give her stars instead;

lines.zh: 中年人说：浪漫是即使晚上加班到零点，到家时，自己家里也还亮着灯；
lines.pinyin: Zhōngnián rén shuō: Làngmàn shì jíshǐ wǎnshang jiā bān dào líng diǎn, dào jiā shí, zìjǐ jiā li yě hái liàngzhe dēng;
lines.en: middle-aged people say: romance is that even if you work overtime until midnight, the light at home is still on when you get there;

lines.zh: 老年人说：浪漫其实就像歌中唱的那样，"我能想到最浪漫的事，就是和你一起慢慢变老。"
lines.pinyin: Lǎonián rén shuō: Làngmàn qíshí jiù xiàng gē zhōng chàng de nàyàng, "Wǒ néng xiǎngdào zuì làngmàn de shì, jiù shì hé nǐ yìqǐ mànmàn biàn lǎo."
lines.en: older people say: romance is really just like the song goes, "The most romantic thing I can think of is slowly growing old together with you."

lines.zh: 其实，让我们感动的，就是生活中简单的爱情。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí, ràng wǒmen gǎndòng de, jiù shì shēnghuó zhōng jiǎndān de àiqíng.
lines.en: In fact, what moves us is the simple love found in everyday life.

lines.zh: 有时候，简单就是最大的幸福。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu shíhou, jiǎndān jiù shì zuì dà de xìngfú.
lines.en: Sometimes, simplicity is the greatest happiness.

lines.zh: 说到结婚，人们就会很自然地想起爱情。
lines.pinyin: Shuōdào jié hūn, rénmen jiù huì hěn zìrán de xiǎngqǐ àiqíng.
lines.en: When it comes to marriage, people naturally think of love.

lines.zh: 爱情是结婚的重要原因，但两个人共同生活，不仅需要浪漫的爱情，更需要性格上互相吸引。
lines.pinyin: Àiqíng shì jié hūn de zhòngyào yuányīn, dàn liǎng ge rén gòngtóng shēnghuó, bùjǐn xūyào làngmàn de àiqíng, gèng xūyào xìnggé shang hùxiāng xīyǐn.
lines.en: Love is an important reason for marriage, but for two people living together, they need not only romantic love, but even more a mutual attraction of personalities.

lines.zh: 我丈夫是个很幽默的人。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhàngfu shì ge hěn yōumò de rén.
lines.en: My husband is a very humorous person.

lines.zh: 即使是很普通的事情，从他嘴里说出来也会变得很有意思。
lines.pinyin: Jíshǐ shì hěn pǔtōng de shìqing, cóng tā zuǐ li shuō chulai yě huì biàn de hěn yǒu yìsi.
lines.en: Even the most ordinary things become interesting when they come out of his mouth.

lines.zh: 在我难过的时候，他总是有办法让我高兴起来。
lines.pinyin: Zài wǒ nánguò de shíhou, tā zǒngshì yǒu bànfǎ ràng wǒ gāoxìng qilai.
lines.en: When I'm feeling down, he always finds a way to cheer me up.

lines.zh: 而且他的脾气也不错，结婚快十年了，我们俩几乎没因为什么事红过脸，很多人都特别羡慕我们。
lines.pinyin: Érqiě tā de píqi yě búcuò, jié hūn kuài shí nián le, wǒmen liǎ jīhū méi yīnwèi shénme shì hóngguo liǎn, hěn duō rén dōu tèbié xiànmù wǒmen.
lines.en: Also, his temper is quite good — we've been married almost ten years, and the two of us have almost never quarreled (lit. "turned red-faced") over anything; a lot of people are especially envious of us.

vocab.en: love (between a man and a woman)

grammar.explanation: The conjunction 不仅 ("not only") is used in the first clause, often echoed by 也/还/而且 ("also/still/moreover") in the second clause, to add a further point beyond what the first clause states. When both clauses share the same subject, 不仅 goes after the subject; when the two clauses have different subjects, 不仅 goes before the first subject.

examples.zh: 他不仅足球踢得好，性格也不错。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn zúqiú tī de hǎo, xìnggé yě búcuò.
examples.en: Not only does he play soccer well, his personality is great too.

examples.zh: 小时候，他经常生病，所以每天都去跑步锻炼身体。谁也没有想到，长大以后，他不仅身体健康，还成了一名长跑运动员。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou, tā jīngcháng shēngbìng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu qù pǎobù duànliàn shēntǐ. Shéi yě méiyǒu xiǎngdào, zhǎngdà yǐhòu, tā bùjǐn shēntǐ jiànkāng, hái chéngle yì míng chángpǎo yùndòngyuán.
examples.en: As a child he was often sick, so he went jogging every day to build up his health. No one expected that when he grew up, not only would he be healthy, he'd even become a long-distance runner.

examples.zh: 我打算去云南 (Yúnnán, name of a Chinese province) 玩儿，听说那边不仅很美，而且人也非常热情。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn qù Yúnnán wánr, tīngshuō nàbiān bùjǐn hěn měi, érqiě rén yě fēicháng rèqíng.
examples.en: I'm planning a trip to Yunnan; I heard that not only is it beautiful there, but the people are also very warm and friendly.

grammar.explanation: The adverb 从来 ("always, all along") indicates that something has been the case continuously from the past up to now. It is mostly used in negative sentences.

examples.zh: 老张这个人开会从来不迟到。今天到现在还没来，可能是有什么事情，你打个电话问问他吧。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Zhāng zhège rén kāihuì cónglái bú chídào. Jīntiān dào xiànzài hái méi lái, kěnéng shì yǒu shénme shìqing, nǐ dǎ ge diànhuà wènwen tā ba.
examples.en: Old Zhang is never late to meetings. He still hasn't shown up today — maybe something's come up; you should give him a call and ask.

examples.zh: 虽然我们认识的时间不长，但我从来没这么快乐过。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen rènshi de shíjiān bù cháng, dàn wǒ cónglái méi zhème kuàilèguo.
examples.en: Although we haven't known each other long, I've never been this happy before.

examples.zh: 这家面馆儿从来只卖一种东西：牛肉面。因为面做得很好吃，而且不贵。很多新客人变成了老客人，老客人又带来更多新客人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā miànguǎnr cónglái zhǐ mài yì zhǒng dōngxi: niúròumiàn. Yīnwèi miàn zuò de hěn hǎochī, érqiě bú guì. Hěn duō xīn kèrén biànchéngle lǎo kèrén, lǎo kèrén yòu dàilái gèng duō xīn kèrén.
examples.en: This noodle shop has always sold only one thing: beef noodles. Because the noodles are delicious and not expensive, many new customers have become regulars, and the regulars keep bringing in even more new customers.

grammar.explanation: The adverb 刚 ("just, not long ago") indicates that an action or situation took place only a short while before. It is placed after the subject and before the verb.

examples.zh: 我上午刚借的那本书，怎么找不到了？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shàngwǔ gāng jiè de nà běn shū, zěnme zhǎo bu dào le?
examples.en: The book I just borrowed this morning — how come I can't find it?

examples.zh: A: 我刚从会议室过来，怎么一个人也没有？ B: 对不起，今天的会议改到明天上午了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ gāng cóng huìyìshì guòlái, zěnme yí ge rén yě méiyǒu? B: Duìbuqǐ, jīntiān de huìyì gǎidào míngtiān shàngwǔ le.
examples.en: A: I just came from the meeting room — why isn't anyone there? B: Sorry, today's meeting got moved to tomorrow morning.

examples.zh: 我和丈夫刚结婚的时候，每天都觉得很新鲜，在一起有说不完的话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé zhàngfu gāng jié hūn de shíhou, měi tiān dōu juéde hěn xīnxiān, zài yìqǐ yǒu shuō bu wán de huà.
examples.en: When my husband and I had just gotten married, every day felt fresh, and we had endless things to talk about together.

grammar.explanation: The conjunction 即使 ("even if") is used in the first clause, usually echoed by 也 ("also, still") in the second. It generally expresses a hypothetical concession, but can also refer to something that has already happened or already exists. 即使 can be placed either before or after the subject of the first clause.

examples.zh: 你应该多回家看看老人，即使只是跟他们吃吃饭、聊聊天，他们也会觉得很幸福。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi duō huí jiā kànkan lǎorén, jíshǐ zhǐshì gēn tāmen chīchi fàn, liáoliao tiān, tāmen yě huì juéde hěn xìngfú.
examples.en: You should go home to see the elderly more often; even if it's just eating a meal or chatting with them, they'll feel very happy.

examples.zh: 大部分人每天晚上最少应该睡7个小时，但有些人即使只睡5个小时也没问题。
examples.pinyin: Dàbùfen rén měi tiān wǎnshang zuìshǎo yīnggāi shuì qī ge xiǎoshí, dàn yǒuxiē rén jíshǐ zhǐ shuì wǔ ge xiǎoshí yě méi wèntí.
examples.en: Most people should sleep at least 7 hours a night, but some people are fine even sleeping only 5 hours.

examples.zh: 浪漫是即使晚上加班到零点，到家时，自己家里也还亮着灯。
examples.pinyin: Làngmàn shì jíshǐ wǎnshang jiā bān dào líng diǎn, dào jiā shí, zìjǐ jiā li yě hái liàngzhe dēng.
examples.en: Romance is that even if you work overtime until midnight, the light at home is still on when you get there.

grammar.explanation: The noun of locality 上 ("on") is used after another noun. Besides meaning "on the surface of an object," it can also indicate "within a certain scope" or "in a certain respect/aspect."

examples.zh: 今天的作业是复习生词，明天课上听写。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de zuòyè shì fùxí shēngcí, míngtiān kè shang tīngxiě.
examples.en: Today's homework is to review the vocabulary; tomorrow there will be a dictation in class.

examples.zh: 来北方好几年了吧？你觉得北方和南方在饮食上有什么不同？
examples.pinyin: Lái běifāng hǎo jǐ nián le ba? Nǐ juéde běifāng hé nánfāng zài yǐnshí shang yǒu shénme bùtóng?
examples.en: You've been in the north for several years now, right? What differences do you think there are between north and south when it comes to food?

examples.zh: 两个人共同生活，不仅需要浪漫的爱情，更需要性格上互相吸引。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén gòngtóng shēnghuó, bùjǐn xūyào làngmàn de àiqíng, gèng xūyào xìnggé shang hùxiāng xīyǐn.
examples.en: For two people living together, they need not only romantic love, but even more a mutual attraction of personalities.

compare.note: Similarity: both indicate that an action or situation happened not long ago, and both can serve as an adverbial modifier (e.g. 你叔叔刚/刚才打电话来说给你发了个电子邮件). Differences: (1) In that shared sense, 刚 is an adverb usable only after the subject and before the verb, while 刚才 is a time noun that can go either before or after the subject (我刚看了邮箱... / 我刚才去洗手间了，你给我打电话了？ / 刚才我去洗手间了，你给我打电话了？). (2) 刚 can be preceded by another time word (我上个月刚结婚...); 刚才 cannot. (3) In a 刚-sentence the verb can be followed by a duration phrase (他刚来一会儿); this is not possible with 刚才. (4) 刚才 can be followed by a negative word (你为什么刚才不说，现在才说？); 刚 cannot.

culture.summary: The seventh day of the seventh lunar month is Qixi Festival, a traditional festival of the Han Chinese. Because the day's activities (needlework, making small handicrafts, offering fruit) are mainly carried out by young women praying for skill, it is also called the "Pleading-for-Skills Festival," "Maiden Festival," or "Girls' Day." Rooted in the folk love story of the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl, it is considered the most romantic traditional festival in China and is regarded as the Chinese Valentine's Day.

texts.label: 课文一
texts.heading_zh: 小夏和马克聊马克的中国朋友
texts.heading_en: Xiao Xia and Mark talk about Mark's Chinese friend

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 来中国快一年了，你适应这儿的生活了吗？
lines.pinyin: Lái Zhōngguó kuài yì nián le, nǐ shìyìng zhèr de shēnghuó le ma?
lines.en: It's been almost a year since you came to China. Have you gotten used to life here?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 开始有点儿不习惯，后来就慢慢适应了，最近我还交了一个中国朋友。
lines.pinyin: Kāishǐ yǒudiǎnr bù xíguàn, hòulái jiù mànmàn shìyìng le, zuìjìn wǒ hái jiāole yí ge Zhōngguó péngyou.
lines.en: At first I was a little unused to it, but later I gradually got used to it. Recently I even made a Chinese friend.

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 那就好，快给我讲讲你新交的中国朋友。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù hǎo, kuài gěi wǒ jiǎngjiang nǐ xīn jiāo de Zhōngguó péngyou.
lines.en: That's good. Quickly tell me about the new Chinese friend you made.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 我们是在图书馆认识的。平时我们常常一起看书、逛街、踢足球。有时候他还给我发一些幽默短信。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen shì zài túshūguǎn rènshi de. Píngshí wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ kàn shū, guàng jiē, tī zúqiú. Yǒu shíhou tā hái gěi wǒ fā yìxiē yōumò duǎnxìn.
lines.en: We met at the library. Normally we often read, stroll the streets, and play soccer together. Sometimes he even sends me some humorous text messages.

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 你的这个朋友真不错！下次介绍我们认识认识，怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de zhège péngyou zhēn búcuò! Xià cì jièshào wǒmen rènshi rènshi, zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: This friend of yours is really great! How about introducing us to each other next time?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 没问题！我们下午要去踢足球，正好一起去吧。
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí! Wǒmen xiàwǔ yào qù tī zúqiú, zhènghǎo yìqǐ qù ba.
lines.en: No problem! We're going to play soccer this afternoon — it's the perfect time, come along.

texts.label: 课文二
texts.heading_zh: 小李和小林聊同学聚会的事情
texts.heading_en: Xiao Li and Xiao Lin talk about the classmate gathering

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.zh: 星期天同学聚会，你能来吗？
lines.pinyin: Xīngqītiān tóngxué jùhuì, nǐ néng lái ma?
lines.en: There's a classmate get-together on Sunday, can you come?

lines.speaker: 小林
lines.zh: 能来。班里同学你联系得怎么样了？来多少人？
lines.pinyin: Néng lái. Bān li tóngxué nǐ liánxì de zěnmeyàng le? Lái duōshao rén?
lines.en: I can come. How's it going with contacting our classmates? How many people are coming?

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.zh: 差不多一半儿吧，张远还专门从国外飞回来呢。
lines.pinyin: Chàbuduō yíbànr ba, Zhāng Yuǎn hái zhuānmén cóng guówài fēi huilai ne.
lines.en: About half, I'd guess. Zhang Yuan is even flying back specially from abroad.

lines.speaker: 小林
lines.zh: 是吗？毕业都快十年了，真想大家啊！对了，今天早上，我在地铁站遇到了王静，她毕业后就去上海工作了，她这次是来旅游的。
lines.pinyin: Shì ma? Bì yè dōu kuài shí nián le, zhēn xiǎng dàjiā a! Duìle, jīntiān zǎoshang, wǒ zài dìtiě zhàn yùdàole Wáng Jìng, tā bì yè hòu jiù qù Shànghǎi gōngzuò le, tā zhè cì shì lái lǚyóu de.
lines.en: Really? It's been almost ten years since graduation, I really miss everyone! By the way, this morning I ran into Wang Jing at the subway station. She went to work in Shanghai after graduating, and this time she's here traveling.

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.zh: 那太好了！麻烦你跟她联系一下，请她一起来参加同学聚会。聚会就在学校门口那个饭店，六点半。别迟到啊！
lines.pinyin: Nà tài hǎo le! Máfan nǐ gēn tā liánxì yíxià, qǐng tā yìqǐ lái cānjiā tóngxué jùhuì. Jùhuì jiù zài xuéxiào ménkǒu nàge fàndiàn, liù diǎn bàn. Bié chídào a!
lines.en: That's great! Would you mind contacting her and inviting her to come to the class gathering too. The gathering is at that restaurant by the school gate, at six thirty. Don't be late!

lines.speaker: 小林
lines.zh: 放心吧。星期天六点半见！
lines.pinyin: Fàng xīn ba. Xīngqītiān liù diǎn bàn jiàn!
lines.en: Don't worry. See you Sunday at six thirty!

texts.label: 课文三
texts.heading_zh: 孙月和王静聊她们的朋友
texts.heading_en: Sun Yue and Wang Jing talk about their friends

lines.speaker: 孙月
lines.zh: 这是什么时候的照片？你真年轻！
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì shénme shíhou de zhàopiàn? Nǐ zhēn niánqīng!
lines.en: When was this photo taken? You look so young!

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 这是上大学时的照片。一看到这张照片，我就想起过去那段快乐的日子，好像重新回到了校园。
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì shàng dàxué shí de zhàopiàn. Yí kàndào zhè zhāng zhàopiàn, wǒ jiù xiǎngqǐ guòqù nà duàn kuàilè de rìzi, hǎoxiàng chóngxīn huídàole xiàoyuán.
lines.en: This is a photo from when I was in college. As soon as I see this photo, I remember that happy time in the past — it's as if I've returned to campus again.

lines.speaker: 孙月
lines.zh: 旁边这个人一定是你的好朋友吧？你们现在还联系吗？
lines.pinyin: Pángbiān zhège rén yídìng shì nǐ de hǎo péngyou ba? Nǐmen xiànzài hái liánxì ma?
lines.en: This person next to you must be your good friend, right? Do you two still keep in touch now?

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 当然了，尽管已经毕业这么多年，我们还是经常联系的，每次都有说不完的话。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán le, jǐnguǎn yǐjīng bì yè zhème duō nián, wǒmen hái shì jīngcháng liánxì de, měi cì dōu yǒu shuō bu wán de huà.
lines.en: Of course. Even though we've been graduated for so many years, we still keep in touch regularly, and every time we have endless things to talk about.

lines.speaker: 孙月
lines.zh: 真羡慕你！我上大学时最好的朋友去了南方工作，我们俩已经好久没联系了。我一会儿就给她打个电话。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn xiànmù nǐ! Wǒ shàng dàxué shí zuì hǎo de péngyou qùle nánfāng gōngzuò, wǒmen liǎng yǐjīng hǎojiǔ méi liánxì le. Wǒ yíhuìr jiù gěi tā dǎ ge diànhuà.
lines.en: I really envy you! My best friend from college went to work in the south, and the two of us haven't been in touch for a long time. I'll give her a call in a bit.

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 对。要知道，能有一个真正的朋友，有一段真正的友谊，是多么不容易！
lines.pinyin: Duì. Yào zhīdào, néng yǒu yí ge zhēnzhèng de péngyou, yǒu yí duàn zhēnzhèng de yǒuyì, shì duōme bù róngyì!
lines.en: Right. You know, how difficult it is to have a true friend and a true friendship!

lines.zh: 每个人都需要朋友，朋友可以丰富我们的生活。
lines.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu xūyào péngyou, péngyou kěyǐ fēngfù wǒmen de shēnghuó.
lines.en: Everyone needs friends; friends can enrich our lives.

lines.zh: 离开朋友，我们的生活一定会非常无聊。
lines.pinyin: Líkāi péngyou, wǒmen de shēnghuó yídìng huì fēicháng wúliáo.
lines.en: Without friends, our lives would definitely be very boring.

lines.zh: 那么，怎样才能交到更多的朋友呢？
lines.pinyin: Nàme, zěnyàng cái néng jiāodào gèng duō de péngyou ne?
lines.en: So, how can we make more friends?

lines.zh: 当然，要有好脾气。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán, yào yǒu hǎo píqi.
lines.en: Of course, you need to have a good temper.

lines.zh: 一个脾气不好的人虽然不一定让人讨厌，但是却很难跟人交朋友。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge píqì bù hǎo de rén suīrán bùyídìng ràng rén tǎoyàn, dànshì què hěn nán gēn rén jiāo péngyou.
lines.en: A person with a bad temper won't necessarily make people dislike them, but it's still hard for them to make friends.

lines.zh: 因为没有人会喜欢跟一个总是容易生气的人在一起。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu rén huì xǐhuan gēn yí ge zǒngshì róngyì shēng qì de rén zài yìqǐ.
lines.en: Because no one likes being around someone who always gets angry easily.

lines.zh: 我们还要经常跟周围的人交流。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen hái yào jīngcháng gēn zhōuwéi de rén jiāoliú.
lines.en: We also need to often communicate with the people around us.

lines.zh: 交流能让人们互相了解，如果有共同的兴趣、爱好或者习惯，就更容易成为朋友了。
lines.pinyin: Jiāoliú néng ràng rénmen hùxiāng liǎojiě, rúguǒ yǒu gòngtóng de xìngqù, àihào huòzhě xíguàn, jiù gèng róngyì chéngwéi péngyou le.
lines.en: Communication lets people understand each other — if you share common interests, hobbies, or habits, it's easier to become friends.

lines.zh: 人的一生可以什么也没有，但不能没有朋友，而且必须要有自己真正的朋友。
lines.pinyin: Rén de yìshēng kěyǐ shénme yě méiyǒu, dàn bù néng méiyǒu péngyou, érqiě bìxū yào yǒu zìjǐ zhēnzhèng de péngyou.
lines.en: A person's life can lack everything else, but it cannot lack friends — and one must have true friends of one's own.

lines.zh: 什么是真正的朋友？
lines.pinyin: Shénme shì zhēnzhèng de péngyou?
lines.en: What is a true friend?

lines.zh: 不同的人会有不同的理解。
lines.pinyin: Bù tóng de rén huì yǒu bù tóng de lǐjiě.
lines.en: Different people have different understandings.

lines.zh: 有些人觉得朋友就是能和自己一起快乐的人；有些人觉得朋友应该像镜子，能帮自己看到缺点。
lines.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén juéde péngyou jiù shì néng hé zìjǐ yìqǐ kuàilè de rén; yǒuxiē rén juéde péngyou yīnggāi xiàng jìngzi, néng bāng zìjǐ kàndào quēdiǎn.
lines.en: Some people think a friend is someone who can be happy together with them; others think a friend should be like a mirror, able to help them see their own shortcomings.

lines.zh: 而我的理解是：当你遇到困难的时候，真正的朋友会站出来，及时给你帮助；当你无聊或者难过的时候，真正的朋友会陪在你身边，想办法让你感到幸福。
lines.pinyin: Ér wǒ de lǐjiě shì: Dāng nǐ yùdào kùnnan de shíhou, zhēnzhèng de péngyou huì zhàn chulai, jíshí gěi nǐ bāngzhù; dāng nǐ wúliáo huòzhě nánguò de shíhou, zhēnzhèng de péngyou huì péi zài nǐ shēnbiān, xiǎng bànfǎ ràng nǐ gǎndào xìngfú.
lines.en: My own understanding is this: when you encounter difficulty, a true friend will step forward and give you timely help; when you are bored or upset, a true friend will stay by your side and think of ways to make you feel happy.

vocab.en: to have a party; party, get-together
Zhang Yuan, name of a person
when, just at (a time or place)

grammar.explanation: As an adjective, “正好” means “just right”, indicating that a certain condition (time, position, size, quantity or degree) is exactly met — neither too early nor too late, neither before nor after, neither too big nor too small, neither too much nor too little, neither too high nor too low. As an adverb, it means it is the right time or opportunity to do something.

examples.zh: 苹果八块五，西瓜十一块五，正好二十块。
examples.pinyin: Píngguǒ bā kuài wǔ, xīguā shíyī kuài wǔ, zhènghǎo èrshí kuài.
examples.en: Apples are 8.5 yuan, watermelon is 11.5 yuan — that comes to exactly 20 yuan.

examples.zh: 你来得正好，我的钱包不见了，借我点儿钱吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái de zhènghǎo, wǒ de qiánbāo bú jiàn le, jiè wǒ diǎnr qián ba.
examples.en: You've come at just the right time — I can't find my wallet, lend me some money.

examples.zh: 我们下午要去踢足球，正好一起去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ yào qù tī zúqiú, zhènghǎo yìqǐ qù ba.
examples.en: We're going to play soccer this afternoon; it's the perfect chance, come along with us.

examples.zh: 我妹妹出生那天，正好下雪，所以爸爸妈妈叫她“小雪”。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei chūshēng nà tiān, zhènghǎo xià xuě, suǒyǐ bàba māma jiào tā “Xiǎoxuě”.
examples.en: The day my younger sister was born, it happened to be snowing, so my parents named her “Xiaoxue” (Little Snow).

grammar.explanation: As an adjective, “差不多” means “approximate” and “without much difference.” As an adverb, it indicates being very close in terms of degree, scope, time, distance or quantity, etc. Compared with “几乎” (see Compare section): (1) in the sense of “very close/similar,” “差不多” can be used right before a monosyllabic adjective, while “几乎” needs extra words before or after the following adjective; (2) “差不多” can precede a numeral-classifier compound to mean close to that quantity, “几乎” cannot; (3) “差不多” can also be a predicate adjective meaning similar/not far apart, “几乎” cannot; (4) “几乎” can indicate an undesirable thing almost happened but ultimately did not, “差不多” cannot.

examples.zh: 这两个电子词典看上去差不多，左边这个怎么这么贵？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge diànzǐ cídiǎn kànshàngqù chàbuduō, zuǒbiān zhège zěnme zhème guì?
examples.en: These two electronic dictionaries look about the same — why is the one on the left so expensive?

examples.zh: 他们俩是在国外旅游的时候认识的，性格差不多，所以很快就成了好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen liǎ shì zài guówài lǚyóu de shíhou rènshi de, xìnggé chàbuduō, suǒyǐ hěn kuài jiù chéngle hǎo péngyou.
examples.en: The two of them met while traveling abroad. Their personalities are quite similar, so they quickly became good friends.

examples.zh: 差不多一半儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Chàbuduō yíbànr ba.
examples.en: About half, I'd guess.

examples.zh: 女儿上中学后，个子长得特别快，现在都快一米七了，差不多跟我一样高了。
examples.pinyin: Nǚ'ér shàng zhōngxué hòu, gèzi zhǎng de tèbié kuài, xiànzài dōu kuài yì mǐ qī le, chàbuduō gēn wǒ yíyàng gāo le.
examples.en: After my daughter started middle school, she grew very quickly in height. She's almost 1.7 meters now — about the same height as me.

examples.zh: 李老师差不多六十岁了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎoshī chàbuduō liùshí suì le.
examples.en: Teacher Li is almost sixty years old.

examples.zh: 姐妹俩性格差不多。
examples.pinyin: Jiěmèi liǎ xìnggé chàbuduō.
examples.en: The two sisters have very similar personalities.

grammar.explanation: The conjunction “尽管” is usually used in the first clause of a complex sentence to state a fact; the second clause introduces a result that would not normally occur given that fact, and is often paired with transition words such as “但是/可是/却/还是.”

examples.zh: 尽管已经毕业这么多年，我们还是经常联系的。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǐjīng bì yè zhème duō nián, wǒmen hái shì jīngcháng liánxì de.
examples.en: Although we graduated so many years ago, we still keep in touch regularly.

examples.zh: 男朋友送给我的这份礼物尽管不贵，但却让我非常感动。
examples.pinyin: Nán péngyou sòng gěi wǒ de zhè fèn lǐwù jǐnguǎn bú guì, dàn què ràng wǒ fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.en: Although the gift my boyfriend gave me wasn't expensive, it moved me very much.

examples.zh: 叔叔最大的爱好就是打篮球，大学时他还多次参加校篮球比赛。尽管现在工作很忙，可到了周末他还是会跟朋友去打球。
examples.pinyin: Shūshu zuì dà de àihào jiù shì dǎ lánqiú, dàxué shí tā hái duō cì cānjiā xiào lánqiú bǐsài. Jǐnguǎn xiànzài gōngzuò hěn máng, kě dàole zhōumò tā hái shì huì gēn péngyou qù dǎ qiú.
examples.en: Uncle's biggest hobby is playing basketball; in college he took part in the school basketball team's games many times. Although he's very busy with work now, on weekends he still goes to play ball with friends.

grammar.explanation: The adverb “却” is used after the subject and before the verb to indicate a transition in meaning, in a relatively mild/soft tone.

examples.zh: 有人觉得有房子和汽车就是幸福，有人却认为找到真正的爱情才是幸福。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén juéde yǒu fángzi hé qìchē jiù shì xìngfú, yǒu rén què rènwéi zhǎodào zhēnzhèng de àiqíng cái shì xìngfú.
examples.en: Some people think having a house and a car is happiness, while others believe that finding true love is what real happiness is.

examples.zh: 一个脾气不好的人虽然不一定让人讨厌，但是却很难跟人交朋友。
examples.pinyin: Yí ge píqi bù hǎo de rén suīrán bùyídìng ràng rén tǎoyàn, dànshì què hěn nán gēn rén jiāo péngyou.
examples.en: A person with a bad temper won't necessarily make people dislike them, but it's still hard for them to make friends.

examples.zh: 现在很多人虽然住在同一个楼里，但是却从来没说过话。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō rén suīrán zhù zài tóng yí ge lóu li, dànshì què cónglái méi shuōguo huà.
examples.en: Nowadays, although many people live in the same building, they've never actually spoken to each other.

grammar.explanation: The conjunction “而” is used in a compound sentence to connect two clauses. It can indicate a coordinate/parallel relationship, and it can also indicate an adversative (contrastive) relationship.

examples.zh: “明”字，左边的“日”意思是太阳，而右边的“月”意思是月亮。
examples.pinyin: “Míng” zì, zuǒbiān de “rì” yìsi shì tàiyáng, ér yòubiān de “yuè” yìsi shì yuèliang.
examples.en: In the character “明” (bright), the “日” on the left means “sun,” while the “月” on the right means “moon.”

examples.zh: 结婚前，我们都要清楚自己想要的是什么，而不要被别人对幸福的看法影响。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn qián, wǒmen dōu yào qīngchu zìjǐ xiǎng yào de shì shénme, ér búyào bèi biérén duì xìngfú de kànfǎ yǐngxiǎng.
examples.en: Before getting married, we should all be clear about what we ourselves want, rather than being influenced by other people's views of happiness.

examples.zh: 在工作中遇到了问题，男人回到家不喜欢跟妻子说，而女人喜欢跟丈夫说。
examples.pinyin: Zài gōngzuò zhōng yùdàole wèntí, nánrén huídào jiā bù xǐhuan gēn qīzi shuō, ér nǚrén xǐhuan gēn zhàngfu shuō.
examples.en: When they run into problems at work, men don't like telling their wives once they get home, whereas women like telling their husbands.

examples.zh: 有些人觉得朋友就是能和自己一起快乐的人，而我的理解是：当你遇到困难的时候，真正的朋友会站出来，及时给你帮助。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén juéde péngyou jiù shì néng hé zìjǐ yìqǐ kuàilè de rén, ér wǒ de lǐjiě shì: dāng nǐ yùdào kùnnan de shíhou, zhēnzhèng de péngyou huì zhàn chulai, jíshí gěi nǐ bāngzhù.
examples.en: Some people think a friend is simply someone who can be happy together with them, whereas my own understanding is: when you run into difficulty, a true friend will step forward and give you timely help.

compare.note: Similarity: Both are adverbs indicating being very close/similar and can serve as an adverbial modifier, e.g. 他汉语说得很好，差不多/几乎跟中国人一样。(He speaks Chinese so well, it's almost like a native.) Differences: 1) In this sense, 差不多 can be placed directly before a monosyllabic adjective (他们俩差不多高。 The two of them are about the same height), while 几乎 requires extra words before or after the adjective that follows (他们俩几乎一样高。 / 他比我几乎高了一头。). 2) 差不多 can precede a numeral-measure phrase to mean 'close to this quantity' (李老师差不多六十岁了。 Teacher Li is almost sixty); 几乎 cannot be used this way. 3) 差不多 can also function as a predicate adjective meaning similar/not far apart (姐妹俩性格差不多。 The two sisters have similar personalities); 几乎 cannot be used this way. 4) 几乎 can indicate that something undesired almost happened but ultimately did not (这件事我几乎忘了告诉你了。 I almost forgot to tell you about this); 差不多 cannot be used this way.

words: 没关系 méi guānxi (it doesn't matter, never mind)

culture.title_zh: 在家靠父母，出门靠朋友
culture.title_en: At Home One Relies on His Parents, While Away from Home One Relies on Friends
culture.summary: 中国有句俗话叫“在家靠父母，出门靠朋友”。朋友在我们的生活中非常重要。交朋友是一种文化，也是一种学问。中国人的交友观可以用八个字来形容，那就是“有福同享，有难同当”，你有什么高兴或者好的事情，说出来与朋友分享；你有什么难处，说出来与朋友一起想解决的办法。多为他人想想，站在别人的立场上想问题更容易获得一份友谊。 English: As the Chinese saying goes, “At home one relies on his parents, while away from home one relies on his friends”. Friends are very important in our lives. Making friends is a type of culture as well as a branch of learning. The Chinese value regarding friendship can be summed up in one sentence—“share each other's joys and sorrows”. Share with your friend the good things that make you happy; tell your friend the problem you've encountered and work out a solution together with your friend. It's easier to earn a friendship if you think more about other people and put yourself in others' shoes.

exercises: 注释1 正好 练一练 Practise (complete the sentences/dialogues, use 正好): (1) 李老师来了，________。（正好） (2) A: 今天开会来了多少人？ B: ________。（正好） (3) A: 明天的球赛你想不想去看？ B: 我当然想去，可惜票早就卖光了。 A: ________，到时候一起去吧。（正好）
注释2 差不多 练一练 Practise (complete the dialogues, use 差不多): (1) A: 照片中间这个男孩儿是你吗？ B: 对，左边这个是我哥哥。 A: ________。（差不多） (2) A: 下个星期就要考试了，你复习得怎么样了？ B: ________。（差不多） (3) A: 你来中国多长时间了？ B: ________。（差不多）

比一比 Compare 差不多—几乎 做一做 Drills (Tick 差不多 and/or 几乎 as appropriate; as printed, rows (1) and (2) are marked, rows (3)-(5) left blank for the learner): (1) 这件事我们班____人人都知道。 [差不多 ✓, 几乎 ✓] (2) 这次考试他们俩的成绩____。 [差不多 ✓, 几乎 ✗] (3) 今天早上起床晚了，上课____迟到了。 (4) 我的房间跟这个教室____大。 (5) 要不是你给我打电话，我____忘了咱俩见面的事。
注释3 尽管 练一练 Practise (complete the sentences/dialogues): (1) 他尽管写得比较慢，________。（但） (2) A: 你们俩才认识不到一个月吧？ B: ________。（尽管） (3) A: 你对这儿的生活习惯了吗？ B: ________。（尽管）
根据课文内容回答问题 Answer the questions based on the texts (课文1-3): 课文1：①马克刚来中国的时候适应这儿的生活吗？现在呢？ ②马克新交的中国朋友怎么样？ 课文2：③小李为什么给小林打电话？ ④他们什么时候聚会？在哪儿聚会？ 课文3：⑤王静看到上大学时的照片会想起什么？ ⑥毕业以后，孙月跟她上大学时最好的朋友还经常联系吗？
注释4 却 练一练 Practise (complete the sentences, use 却): (1) 他喜欢锻炼身体，他弟弟________。（却） (2) 虽然她俩是姐妹，________。（却） (3) ________；有的人吃得很少，但不瘦。（却）
注释5 而 练一练 Practise (complete the sentences, use 而): (1) 现在越来越多的年轻人愿意旅行结婚，________。（而） (2) 老年人喜欢往回看，想一想过去的事情；________。（而） (3) 有的地方一年四季都可以见到雪，________。（而）
根据课文内容回答问题 Answer the questions based on the texts (课文4-5): 课文4：①如果没有朋友，我们的生活会怎么样？ ②怎样才能交到更多的朋友？ 课文5：③什么是真正的朋友？ ④关于朋友，你的理解是什么？
练习1 复述 Retell the dialogues: 课文1（马克的语气）：我叫马克，我来中国快一年了。…… 课文2（小林的语气）：小李打电话告诉我星期天同学聚会，…… 课文3（孙月的语气）：今天我看了王静上大学时的照片，……

练习2 选择合适的词语填空 Choose the proper words to fill in the blanks. Word bank A（周围 理解 无聊 适应 镜子）: ①每个人对幸福都有不同的________。 ②我喜欢现在住的地方，很方便。不像以前住的地方，________一个超市都没有。 ③生活就像________，你对它笑，它也对你笑；如果你对它哭，它也对你哭。 ④周末总是一个人在家太________了，你应该找朋友出去逛逛街、看看电影、吃吃饭。 ⑤我刚来这儿的时候很不________，后来慢慢习惯了，也交到了很多朋友，我越来越喜欢这儿的生活了。 Word bank B（好像 麻烦 联系 平时 陪）: ⑥A: 上车吧，我送你。 B: 不________你了，我坐出租车回去。 ⑦A: 周末的同学聚会你参加吗？ B: 当然，有几个同学毕业后就没________了，正好借这个机会见见。 ⑧A: 都九点了，你怎么还不起床？ B: 昨晚看足球比赛看到两点半，这不是周六吗？________哪能睡到九点？ ⑨A: 小李，那个女孩儿是谁啊？你认识？ B: 应该不认识，但是________在哪儿见过。 ⑩A: 经理，我丈夫生病了。我想请一天假，________他去医院看看。 B: 好，你先把家里照顾好，工作的事别担心。

扩展 Expansion 同字词 Words with the Same Character — 系：联系、关系、没关系 (illustrative dialogues): (1) A: 喂，喂，你在哪儿呢？怎么听不清楚你说话？ B: 我现在在火车站，人太多了，过会儿我再跟你联系吧。 (2) A: 你和她关系那么好，能帮我介绍一下吗？ B: 没问题，下次我们学校开舞会时我叫你来。 (3) A: 你怎么了？是不是太累了？ B: 我可能有点儿发烧，没关系，休息一下就好了。

同字词 做一做 Drills 选词填空 Fill in the blanks with 联系/关系/没关系: ①A: 奇怪，我记得这条街上有一个咖啡馆的。 B: ________，我们找个地方坐坐就行。 ②A: 你好，请问小李在家吗？ B: 他不在家，他游泳去了。 A: 好的，那我过一会儿再________他吧，谢谢，再见。 ③A: 你们两个的________很不错？ B: 是，在我们班里，她是我最好的朋友。
