texts.label: 课文1
texts.heading_zh: 小李和小林聊天气和身体情况
texts.heading_en: Xiao Li and Xiao Lin chat about the weather and their health

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.zh: 你的鼻子怎么流血了？快用纸擦擦。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de bízi zěnme liú xiě le? Kuài yòng zhǐ cāca.
lines.en: Why is your nose bleeding? Quick, wipe it with a tissue.

lines.speaker: 小林
lines.zh: 我还不习惯北方的气候，估计是天气太干。今天天气不是很冷，你怎么穿这么多？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hái bù xíguàn běifāng de qìhòu, gūjì shì tiānqì tài gān. Jīntiān tiānqì bú shì hěn lěng, nǐ zěnme chuān zhème duō?
lines.en: I'm still not used to the climate in the north — I guess it's because the weather is too dry. It's not very cold today, so why are you wearing so much?

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.zh: 就是因为昨天穿得太少，我都感冒了。
lines.pinyin: Jiù shì yīnwèi zuótiān chuān de tài shǎo, wǒ dōu gǎnmào le.
lines.en: It's exactly because I wore too little yesterday that I caught a cold.

lines.speaker: 小林
lines.zh: 最近感冒的人特别多。你去看医生了吗？
lines.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén tèbié duō. Nǐ qù kàn yīshēng le ma?
lines.en: There have been a lot of people catching colds lately. Did you go see a doctor?

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.zh: 没有，我只是咳嗽，有点儿头疼，不严重，多喝点儿水就好了。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu, wǒ zhǐ shì késou, yǒudiǎnr tóu téng, bù yánzhòng, duō hē diǎnr shuǐ jiù hǎo le.
lines.en: No. I just have a cough and a bit of a headache — it's not serious, I'll be fine once I drink more water.

lines.speaker: 小林
lines.zh: 春天天气时冷时热，特别容易感冒。这时候一定要多注意保暖，另外，最好经常打开窗户换换空气。
lines.pinyin: Chūntiān tiānqì shí lěng shí rè, tèbié róngyì gǎnmào. Zhè shíhou yídìng yào duō zhùyì bǎonuǎn, lìngwài, zuìhǎo jīngcháng dǎkāi chuānghu huànhuan kōngqì.
lines.en: In spring the weather is sometimes cold and sometimes hot, so it's especially easy to catch a cold. At times like this you must be careful to keep warm, and besides, it's best to open the windows often to get some fresh air.

texts.label: 课文2
texts.heading_zh: 小夏和小雨聊小雨抽烟的事情
texts.heading_en: Xiao Xia and Xiao Yu talk about Xiao Yu's smoking

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 你咳嗽好点儿了吗？医生怎么说的？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ késou hǎo diǎnr le ma? Yīshēng zěnme shuō de?
lines.en: Is your cough any better? What did the doctor say?

lines.speaker: 小雨
lines.zh: 还是老样子，他让我以后不要再抽烟了。
lines.pinyin: Hái shì lǎo yàngzi, tā ràng wǒ yǐhòu bú yào zài chōu yān le.
lines.en: Still the same as before. He told me not to smoke anymore.

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 抽烟对身体一点儿好处也没有。
lines.pinyin: Chōu yān duì shēntǐ yìdiǎnr hǎochù yě méiyǒu.
lines.en: Smoking doesn't do your health any good at all.

lines.speaker: 小雨
lines.zh: 我也知道，可是我觉得抽烟这个动作看上去很帅。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhīdào, kěshì wǒ juéde chōu yān zhège dòngzuò kàn shangqu hěn shuài.
lines.en: I know that too, but I feel like the action of smoking looks cool.

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 等你身体出现问题了，后悔就来不及了。
lines.pinyin: Děng nǐ shēntǐ chūxiàn wèntí le, hòuhuǐ jiù láibují le.
lines.en: By the time your health develops problems, it'll be too late to regret it.

lines.speaker: 小雨
lines.zh: 其实家人也一直反对我抽烟，我自己却觉得没什么。但最近总是咳嗽，所以我有些担心了。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí jiārén yě yìzhí fǎnduì wǒ chōu yān, wǒ zìjǐ què juéde méi shénme. Dàn zuìjìn zǒngshì késou, suǒyǐ wǒ yǒuxiē dān xīn le.
lines.en: Actually, my family has always been against my smoking too, but I myself feel it's not a big deal. But lately I've been coughing all the time, so I've gotten a bit worried.

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 抽烟不仅对自己没好处，还会影响周围人的身体健康。为了你和你的家人，别再抽了。
lines.pinyin: Chōu yān bùjǐn duì zìjǐ méi hǎochù, hái huì yǐngxiǎng zhōuwéi rén de shēntǐ jiànkāng. Wèile nǐ hé nǐ de jiārén, bié zài chōu le.
lines.en: Smoking isn't just bad for you — it also affects the health of the people around you. For your sake and your family's sake, stop smoking.

texts.label: 课文3
texts.heading_zh: 小李和小林聊电脑对身体的影响
texts.heading_en: Xiao Li and Xiao Lin talk about the effect of computers on health

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.zh: 我最近眼睛总是跳，大夫说是因为我长时间看电脑，眼睛太累。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn yǎnjing zǒngshì tiào, dàifu shuō shì yīnwèi wǒ cháng shíjiān kàn diànnǎo, yǎnjing tài lèi.
lines.en: My eye has been twitching lately. The doctor said it's because I look at the computer for long periods and my eyes get too tired.

lines.speaker: 小林
lines.zh: 长时间坐在电脑前面工作，眼睛很容易累。最好是每过一小时就休息休息，然后再开始工作。
lines.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān zuò zài diànnǎo qiánmian gōngzuò, yǎnjing hěn róngyì lèi. Zuìhǎo shì měi guò yì xiǎoshí jiù xiūxi xiūxi, ránhòu zài kāishǐ gōngzuò.
lines.en: Sitting in front of a computer working for long periods makes the eyes tired easily. It's best to rest for a bit every hour, and then start working again.

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.zh: 医生也这么说，他还告诉我要多向远处看看，尤其是多看看绿色的植物。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng yě zhème shuō, tā hái gàosu wǒ yào duō xiàng yuǎn chù kànkan, yóuqí shì duō kànkan lǜsè de zhíwù.
lines.en: The doctor said the same thing. He also told me to look into the distance more often, especially to look at green plants.

lines.speaker: 小林
lines.zh: 长时间对着电脑不仅对眼睛不好，身体也会不舒服。研究发现，如果人一天静坐超过6小时，就会影响身体健康。
lines.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān duìzhe diànnǎo bùjǐn duì yǎnjing bù hǎo, shēntǐ yě huì bù shūfu. Yánjiū fāxiàn, rúguǒ rén yì tiān jìng zuò chāoguò liù xiǎoshí, jiù huì yǐngxiǎng shēntǐ jiànkāng.
lines.en: Facing a computer for long periods isn't just bad for the eyes — the body feels uncomfortable too. Research has found that if a person sits still for more than 6 hours a day, it will affect their health.

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.zh: 是啊！像咱们这些久坐办公室的人要注意，有时间应该多站起来活动活动。
lines.pinyin: Shì a! Xiàng zánmen zhèxiē jiǔ zuò bàngōngshì de rén yào zhùyì, yǒu shíjiān yīnggāi duō zhàn qǐlai huódòng huódòng.
lines.en: That's right! People like us who sit in an office for long periods need to be careful — whenever we have time we should stand up and move around a bit.

lines.speaker: 小林
lines.zh: 好，咱们午饭后就去附近的公园散散步吧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, zánmen wǔfàn hòu jiù qù fùjìn de gōngyuán sànsan bù ba.
lines.en: Okay, let's go for a walk in the nearby park after lunch.

lines.zh: 每个人都希望自己健康，那么什么才是健康呢？
lines.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu xīwàng zìjǐ jiànkāng, nàme shénme cái shì jiànkāng ne?
lines.en: Everyone hopes to be healthy — so what exactly counts as health?

lines.zh: 过去，人们认为健康就是指身体不生病。
lines.pinyin: Guòqù, rénmen rènwéi jiànkāng jiù shì zhǐ shēntǐ bù shēng bìng.
lines.en: In the past, people believed that health simply meant the body not getting sick.

lines.zh: 但是，现在人们认识到，健康还指精神上的健康。
lines.pinyin: Dànshì, xiànzài rénmen rènshi dào, jiànkāng hái zhǐ jīngshén shang de jiànkāng.
lines.en: But now people have come to realize that health also refers to being healthy mentally.

lines.zh: 只有身体和精神都健康，才算是真正的健康。
lines.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu shēntǐ hé jīngshén dōu jiànkāng, cái suàn shì zhēnzhèng de jiànkāng.
lines.en: Only when both body and mind are healthy can it be considered true health.

lines.zh: 有一位教授用数字来说明健康有多么重要：要是健康是1，其他都是1后面的0；如果没有1，不管有多少0也没用。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yí wèi jiàoshòu yòng shùzì lái shuōmíng jiànkāng yǒu duōme zhòngyào: Yàoshi jiànkāng shì yī, qítā dōu shì yī hòumiàn de líng; rúguǒ méiyǒu yī, bùguǎn yǒu duōshao líng yě méi yòng.
lines.en: One professor used numbers to explain just how important health is: if health is the number 1, everything else is a 0 after it; if there's no 1, no matter how many 0s there are, they're useless.

lines.zh: 所以我们平时一定要注意锻炼，别等健康出问题了才后悔。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ wǒmen píngshí yídìng yào zhùyì duànliàn, bié děng jiànkāng chū wèntí le cái hòuhuǐ.
lines.en: So in everyday life we must be sure to exercise regularly, and not wait until health problems appear before regretting it.

lines.zh: 我听一位医生说过一句话：“最好的医生是自己，最好的药是时间，最好的运动是散步。”
lines.pinyin: Wǒ tīng yí wèi yīshēng shuōguo yí jù huà: “Zuì hǎo de yīshēng shì zìjǐ, zuì hǎo de yào shì shíjiān, zuì hǎo de yùndòng shì sàn bù.”
lines.en: I once heard a doctor say something: “The best doctor is yourself, the best medicine is time, and the best exercise is taking a walk.”

lines.zh: 前两条我理解得不深，最后一条我完全同意。
lines.pinyin: Qián liǎng tiáo wǒ lǐjiě de bù shēn, zuìhòu yì tiáo wǒ wánquán tóngyì.
lines.en: I don't understand the first two points very deeply, but I completely agree with the last one.

lines.zh: 散步是生活中最简单的锻炼方法，既可以活动身体，又可以减肥，而且不会像跑步那样辛苦。
lines.pinyin: Sàn bù shì shēnghuó zhōng zuì jiǎndān de duànliàn fāngfǎ, jì kěyǐ huódòng shēntǐ, yòu kěyǐ jiǎn féi, érqiě bú huì xiàng pǎo bù nàyàng xīnkǔ.
lines.en: Taking a walk is the simplest form of exercise in life — it lets you move your body and lose weight, and it isn't as tiring as running.

lines.zh: 晚饭后，一家人一起出去散散步，是一件很幸福的事情。
lines.pinyin: Wǎnfàn hòu, yì jiā rén yìqǐ chūqu sànsan bù, shì yí jiàn hěn xìngfú de shìqing.
lines.en: After dinner, going out for a walk together as a family is a very happy thing.

lines.zh: 肚子吃饱了需要活动，家人忙了一天需要交流，夫妻说说一天的工作能加深感情，听孩子谈谈学校里有意思的事，一天的烦恼就都跑掉了。
lines.pinyin: Dùzi chībǎo le xūyào huódòng, jiārén mángle yì tiān xūyào jiāoliú, fūqī shuōshuo yì tiān de gōngzuò néng jiāshēn gǎnqíng, tīng háizi tántan xuéxiào li yǒuyìsi de shì, yì tiān de fánnǎo jiù dōu pǎodiào le.
lines.en: A full stomach needs movement, and a family that's been busy all day needs to talk — a couple chatting about their day's work can deepen their affection, and listening to the kids talk about interesting things at school makes a whole day's worries just melt away.

vocab.en: to have not enough time to, to be too late to
used after certain verbs, indicating the result of an action

grammar.explanation: The verb “估计” means to draw a rough inference from certain conditions.

examples.zh: 我还不习惯北方的气候，估计是天气太干。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái bù xíguàn běifāng de qìhòu, gūjì shì tiānqì tài gān.
examples.en: I'm still not used to the climate in the north; I reckon it's because the weather is too dry.

examples.zh: 你有没有去问问小王？估计他应该有办法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu qù wènwen Xiǎo Wáng? Gūjì tā yīnggāi yǒu bànfǎ.
examples.en: Did you go ask Xiao Wang? I'd guess he should have a way to handle it.

examples.zh: 机场通知飞机晚点一个小时，估计他下午六点才能到上海。
examples.pinyin: Jīchǎng tōngzhī fēijī wǎndiǎn yí ge xiǎoshí, gūjì tā xiàwǔ liù diǎn cái néng dào Shànghǎi.
examples.en: The airport announced the flight is delayed by an hour; I estimate he won't reach Shanghai until 6pm.

grammar.explanation: The verb “来不及” indicates something cannot be done because time is short. It can either be used independently or be followed by verbs.

examples.zh: 等你身体出现问题了，后悔就来不及了。
examples.pinyin: Děng nǐ shēntǐ chūxiàn wèntí le, hòuhuǐ jiù láibují le.
examples.en: By the time your health develops problems, it'll be too late to regret it.

examples.zh: 今天来不及开会了，明天我们再找时间说这个问题吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān láibují kāihuì le, míngtiān wǒmen zài zhǎo shíjiān shuō zhège wèntí ba.
examples.en: There isn't enough time for a meeting today; let's find time tomorrow to discuss this.

examples.zh: 你不是和同学约了下午两点见面吗？再不走就来不及了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì hé tóngxué yuē le xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn jiànmiàn ma? Zài bù zǒu jiù láibují le.
examples.en: Didn't you arrange to meet your classmate at 2pm? If you don't leave now you'll be too late.

grammar.explanation: The reduplication of a separable word may indicate a short time, an attempt or randomness among other things, the form being “AAB”, such as “散散步 (to go for a walk)”, “帮帮忙 (to do a favour)”, “睡睡觉 (to have some sleep)” and “游游泳 (to go swimming)”.

examples.zh: 咱们午饭后就去附近的公园散散步吧。
examples.pinyin: Zánmen wǔfàn hòu jiù qù fùjìn de gōngyuán sànsan bù ba.
examples.en: Let's go for a walk in the nearby park after lunch.

examples.zh: 行李箱怎么这么重啊！你快来帮帮我的忙。
examples.pinyin: Xínglixiāng zěnme zhème zhòng a! Nǐ kuài lái bāngbang wǒ de máng.
examples.en: Why is this suitcase so heavy! Come and give me a hand.

examples.zh: 周末马克一般在宿舍看看书、听听音乐、睡睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò Mǎkè yìbān zài sùshè kànkan shū, tīngting yīnyuè, shuìshui jiào.
examples.en: On weekends Mark usually stays in the dorm reading a little, listening to some music, and napping.

grammar.explanation: The conjunction “要是” means “if, in case”, usually used in the structure “要是……(的话), 就……”, in which “要是” introduces a sentence indicating an assumption, and “就” introduces a sentence indicating the action or result consequent upon the assumed situation.

examples.zh: 要是健康是1，其他都是1后面的0。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi jiànkāng shì yī, qítā dōu shì yī hòumiàn de líng.
examples.en: If health is the number 1, everything else is a 0 that comes after it.

examples.zh: 要是你想来中国的大学留学，和中国学生一起学习专业课，那么就需要做好这些准备。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng lái Zhōngguó de dàxué liúxué, hé Zhōngguó xuésheng yìqǐ xuéxí zhuānyè kè, nàme jiù xūyào zuò hǎo zhèxiē zhǔnbèi.
examples.en: If you want to study at a Chinese university and take major courses alongside Chinese students, then you need to make these preparations.

examples.zh: 要是质量比别人的好的话，那么价格贵一点儿也是可以接受的。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi zhìliàng bǐ biéren de hǎo dehuà, nàme jiàgé guì yìdiǎnr yě shì kěyǐ jiēshòu de.
examples.en: If the quality is better than others', then it's acceptable for the price to be a bit higher too.

grammar.explanation: The set of conjunctions “既……又/也/还……” is used to connect two verbal structures or adjectives (usually the same in structure), indicating two situations, both positive or both negative, existing at the same time.

examples.zh: 散步是生活中最简单的锻炼方法，既可以活动身体，又可以减肥。
examples.pinyin: Sàn bù shì shēnghuó zhōng zuì jiǎndān de duànliàn fāngfǎ, jì kěyǐ huódòng shēntǐ, yòu kěyǐ jiǎn féi.
examples.en: Taking a walk is the simplest form of exercise in life — it both moves the body and helps you lose weight.

examples.zh: 成功离不开交流，交流自然需要说话。会说话的人既容易交到朋友，也容易获得成功。
examples.pinyin: Chénggōng líbukāi jiāoliú, jiāoliú zìrán xūyào shuōhuà. Huì shuōhuà de rén jì róngyì jiāo dào péngyou, yě róngyì huòdé chénggōng.
examples.en: Success can't happen without communication, and communication naturally requires talking. People who are good talkers both make friends easily and achieve success easily.

examples.zh: 他那个人做事既不认真，动作还慢，这个工作这么重要，还是让别人做吧。
examples.pinyin: Tā nàge rén zuòshì jì bú rènzhēn, dòngzuò hái màn, zhège gōngzuò zhème zhòngyào, háishi ràng biéren zuò ba.
examples.en: That person is neither careful in his work nor quick about it; this job is too important, so we'd better let someone else do it.

compare.note: Similarity: both indicate a rough inference drawn from certain conditions, e.g. 今天的工作估计/可能完不成了，因为出了点儿问题 (“Today's work probably won't get finished, because something went wrong”). Differences: (1) In this sense 估计 is a verb that can serve directly as the predicate, followed by a verb or a clause; 可能 is a modal verb that can only stand before a verb to modify it, with that verb as the true predicate, e.g. 明天就可以上网查成绩了，我估计这次考试考得不错 / 明天就可以上网查成绩了，我这次考试估计/可能考得不错。 (2) 可能 can also be used as an adjective meaning “possible, able to come true”; 估计 cannot, e.g. 他这么多天没来上课，最可能的原因就是他回国了 (“He hasn't come to class for so many days; the most likely reason is that he's gone back to his home country”). (3) 可能 can follow 很 to form 很可能 (“very likely”), used either before or after the subject to strengthen the affirmation; 估计 cannot, e.g. 很可能他还不知道这件事 / 他很可能还不知道这件事 (“He very likely doesn't know about this yet”).

culture.summary: 太极是中国古代哲学思想中重要的基本概念，指宇宙的本原。太极拳是一种以太极阴阳为基本理念，结合艺术、中医等理论的一种武术拳法。太极拳动作柔和，速度比较慢，而且学起来也不难，尤其适合中老年人练习。每个人可以根据自己的身体情况，选择合适的运动量。经常练习太极拳，不仅可以保持身体健康，而且还能提高人的修养。 / English (as printed): Taiji is a basic concept in ancient Chinese philosophy, referring to the origin of the universe. With taiji and yin-yang as its theoretical basis, taijiquan, or Chinese shadow boxing, is a martial art of boxing integrating theories of art and traditional Chinese medicine, etc. Its movements being gentle, slow and easy to learn, taijiquan is particularly suitable for middle-aged and senior citizens. Everybody can choose an appropriate workout to practise it according to their own physical conditions. To regularly practise taijiquan can help people improve themselves both physically and mentally.

exercises: 练一练 (估计) Complete the sentences: (1) ______，我们还是下次再去吧。（估计） (2) 我现在就过去，______。（估计） (3) 你可以上网买书，______。（估计）

做一做 选词填空 Tick or cross (估计 vs 可能), p.82: (1) 那个饭馆儿去晚了人特别多，要等很长时间，这会儿去______来不及了。[book answer key: 估计✓ 可能✓] (2) 还有一分钟比赛就结束了，我______他们没机会再进球了。[book answer key: 估计✓ 可能✗] (3) 已经这么晚了，老师______休息了，你别打电话了。 (4) 我看这是不______的事情，网上的消息可不能全信。 (5) 你看，那个人最______想做什么？ (items 3–5 left blank in the book for students to complete)
练一练 (来不及) Complete the sentences: (1) 节目8点开始，______。（来不及） (2) 我本来打算去图书馆还书，______。（来不及） (3) ______，原来飞机10点才起飞。（来不及）
练一练 (离合词重叠) Complete the sentences: (1) 你有时间应该多回家看看爸妈，______。（聊天儿） (2) ______，对身体特别好。（游泳） (3) 我帮你跟小李联系好了，______。（见面）
根据课文内容回答问题 (Answer the questions based on the texts), 课文1–3: ①小林可能是中国哪里人？为什么？ ②春天的时候怎么才能少感冒？ ③小雨为什么喜欢抽烟？你同意小雨的想法吗？为什么？ ④如果你有抽烟的朋友，你想对他/她说些什么？ ⑤长时间坐在电脑前面工作好不好？为什么？ ⑥要是你需要长时间用电脑工作，你会怎么保证自己的身体健康？
练一练 (要是) Complete the sentences: (1) ______，20分钟就能到。（要是） (2) ______，可能不够，再买两瓶吧。（要是……的话） (3) 你要是有时间，______。（就）
练一练 (既……又/也/还……) Complete the dialogues/sentences: (1) A：这两件衣服太漂亮了，你打算买哪件？ B：______。（既……又……） (2) 来中国学习汉语，______。（既……也……） (3) 我们都愿意跟他交朋友，______。（既……还……）
根据课文内容回答问题，课文4–5: ①过去和现在的人们对健康的认识有哪些不同？ ②那位教授用什么方法说明健康是非常重要的？ ③“我”是怎么理解“最好的运动是散步”这句话的？ ④晚饭后和家人一起去散散步有哪几个方面的好处？
练习1 复述 Retell the dialogues, using the cue given: 课文1（小林的语气）：昨天我的鼻子又流血了，…… 课文2（小雨的语气）：医生让我以后别抽烟了，…… 课文3（小林的语气）：长时间坐在电脑前面工作，……

练习2 选择合适的词语填空 Choose the proper words to fill in the blanks. Bank A（后悔/擦/反对/动作/指）：①经理让服务员把所有桌子都______干净。②第一印象是______在第一次见面时给别人留下的印象。③生气时不要急着做决定，因为这个时候做的决定可能让你______。④他对自己的要求很高，希望比赛的时候把每个______都做好。⑤我本来以为她会______我这么做，没想到她竟然支持我。 Bank B（严重/研究/辛苦/超过/出现）：⑥A：你的腿怎么了？快坐下休息一会儿吧。B：没事儿，大夫说不______。⑦A：你看一下，现在有多少人同意这个计划？B：一共有十五个人，______了三分之二。⑧A：今天的晚饭怎么样？B：特别好吃，______你了，一会儿我来洗碗。⑨A：你觉得老孙这个人怎么样？B：老孙是个非常热情的人，他总是能在第一时间______，帮助大家解决问题。⑩A：你毕业后有什么打算？留北京还是回江西（Jiāngxī，一个中国省份的名字）？B：还没决定，我在考虑要不要读______生。
扩展 同字词 气：生气、脾气、空气、气候 — example sentences: (1) 别生气了，我刚才真的是跟你开玩笑的。 (2) 他不但能力强，而且脾气好，毕业后一定能找到一份好工作。 (3) 因为太高，这里空气比别的地方少，刚到这里的人会感觉身体不舒服。 (4) 这次活动是从2007年开始的，它使人们更加关心世界气候变化的问题了。

做一做 选词填空 Fill in the blanks with 生气/脾气/空气/气候: ①A：听说你去丽江玩儿了？那儿怎么样？B：那里特别美，______也很新鲜。②A：为什么有的孩子喜欢发______呢？B：他们主要是想从爸妈那里得到一些好处。③A：来北方好几年了吧？你觉得北方和南方的______一样吗？B：夏天差不多，但是冬天北方比较干。④A：你怎么还没到啊！我已经等了你一个小时了。B：别______，我马上就到门口了。
运用1 双人活动 Pair Work — 互相了解对方对气候的适应情况，完成调查表：1.你对现在生活的地方的气候习惯吗？（如果不习惯，请做第4、5题）2.说说这里的气候有什么特点。3.要是有重新选择的机会，你会选择在什么样气候的地方生活？为什么？4.这个地方气候的哪些方面你还不适应？5.这里的气候对你的身体和生活有什么影响？你是怎么解决这些问题的？

运用2 小组活动 Group Work — 运动的方法有很多种，向小组成员介绍一下你最喜欢哪（几）种运动。（请最少用四个下面的结构）Tell group members about your favourite sport(s), using at least four of the following phrases drawn from the lesson: a.天气时冷时热 b.身体出现问题 c.动作看上去很帅 d.影响身体健康 e.最简单的锻炼方法 f.理解得不深 g.等身体出问题了 h.烦恼都跑掉了

title.en: Beauty is not rare in life

warmup: 1. 给下边的词语选择对应的图片 Match the pictures with the words. Six photos (A-F: A a display case of chocolates; B a green river/forest scenic view; C a jammed multi-lane road full of cars; D two hands holding soil with a small seedling growing; E a building with a flag flying in front of it; F a green taxi stopped in traffic with its driver visible) are to be matched with six words: ① 大使馆 dàshǐguǎn (embassy) ___ ② 师傅 shīfu (master worker/driver) ___ ③ 景色 jǐngsè (scenery) ___ ④ 生命 shēngmìng (life) ___ ⑤ 巧克力 qiǎokèlì (chocolate) ___ ⑥ 堵车 dǔ chē (traffic jam) ___ (blanks left for students to fill in the matching letter; no answer key printed).

2. 生活中的礼物 Presents in your life. Tick-box questionnaire with four columns: 什么时候送礼物 (When to give a gift: 生日 birthday / 结婚 wedding / 回国 returning to one's home country / 朋友心情不好 when a friend is in a bad mood); 价格 (Price: 越贵越好 the more expensive the better / 不能太贵 shouldn't be too expensive / 价格没关系 price doesn't matter); 什么时候看礼物 (When to look at the gift: 马上打开看 open and look right away / 回家自己看 look at it alone at home / 先放一段时间 set it aside for a while first); 怎么送礼物 (How to give it: 当面送 give it in person / 邮寄 mail it / 让朋友帮我送 have a friend deliver it for me). Students check the boxes that reflect their own habits; no answer key printed.

texts.label: 课文1
texts.heading_zh: 李老师和高老师聊关于巧克力的事情
texts.heading_en: Teacher Li and Teacher Gao chat about chocolate

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.zh: 这种巧克力味道不错，你在哪儿买的？
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qiǎokèlì wèidào búcuò, nǐ zài nǎr mǎi de?
lines.en: This chocolate tastes pretty good. Where did you buy it?

lines.speaker: 高老师
lines.zh: 不是我买的，是我女儿给我从国外带回来的礼物。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì wǒ mǎi de, shì wǒ nǚ'ér gěi wǒ cóng guówài dài huilai de lǐwù.
lines.en: I didn't buy it. It's a present my daughter brought back for me from abroad.

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.zh: 很多人出国后常常会买外国的巧克力，回来送给亲戚朋友。
lines.pinyin: Hěn duō rén chū guó hòu chángcháng huì mǎi wàiguó de qiǎokèlì, huílai sònggěi qīnqi péngyou.
lines.en: A lot of people often buy foreign chocolate when they go abroad, and bring it back as gifts for relatives and friends.

lines.speaker: 高老师
lines.zh: 是啊，因为很多人都爱吃巧克力，尤其是女性。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, yīnwèi hěn duō rén dōu ài chī qiǎokèlì, yóuqí shì nǚxìng.
lines.en: Yes, because a lot of people love eating chocolate, especially women.

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.zh: 这是为什么呢？
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì wèi shénme ne?
lines.en: Why is that?

lines.speaker: 高老师
lines.zh: 巧克力大多是甜的，而很多女性都喜欢吃甜的。而且，听说伤心难过的时候吃块儿巧克力，还能使人的心情变得愉快。
lines.pinyin: Qiǎokèlì dàduō shì tián de, ér hěn duō nǚxìng dōu xǐhuan chī tián de. Érqiě, tīngshuō shāng xīn nánguò de shíhou chī kuàir qiǎokèlì, hái néng shǐ rén de xīnqíng biàn de yúkuài.
lines.en: Chocolate is mostly sweet, and a lot of women like eating sweet things. Also, I've heard that eating a piece of chocolate when you're sad can even make a person's mood turn cheerful.

texts.label: 课文2
texts.heading_zh: 小夏和马克聊关于上次足球比赛的事情
texts.heading_en: Xiao Xia and Mark chat about the last soccer match

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 这里的景色真美，空气也好。
lines.pinyin: Zhèli de jǐngsè zhēn měi, kōngqì yě hǎo.
lines.en: The scenery here is really beautiful, and the air is good too.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 怎么样，心情好些了吗？
lines.pinyin: Zěnmeyàng, xīnqíng hǎoxiē le ma?
lines.en: So, are you in a better mood now?

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 好多了，上次足球比赛后，好久都没这么放松了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎoduō le, shàng cì zúqiú bǐsài hòu, hǎojiǔ dōu méi zhème fàngsōng le.
lines.en: Much better. I haven't felt this relaxed in a long time, not since the last soccer match.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 你不要有压力，好好儿准备下次比赛就好了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ búyào yǒu yālì, hǎohāor zhǔnbèi xià cì bǐsài jiù hǎo le.
lines.en: Don't put pressure on yourself. Just prepare well for the next match and it'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 这段时间我总是一个人坐在房间里回忆那次比赛。如果我们能再努力一点儿，就一定会多进一个球。
lines.pinyin: Zhè duàn shíjiān wǒ zǒngshì yí ge rén zuò zài fángjiān li huíyì nà cì bǐsài. Rúguǒ wǒmen néng zài nǔlì yìdiǎnr, jiù yídìng huì duō jìn yí ge qiú.
lines.en: Lately I've always been sitting alone in my room thinking back on that match. If we had tried just a bit harder, we definitely would have scored one more goal.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 事情已经发生了，过去的就让它成为过去吧。只要这次你好好儿准备，一定能把比赛踢好。
lines.pinyin: Shìqing yǐjīng fāshēng le, guòqù de jiù ràng tā chéngwéi guòqù ba. Zhǐyào zhè cì nǐ hǎohāor zhǔnbèi, yídìng néng bǎ bǐsài tīhǎo.
lines.en: It already happened — just let the past be the past. As long as you prepare well this time, you'll definitely be able to play the match well.

texts.label: 课文3
texts.heading_zh: 马克和司机聊关于堵车的事情
texts.heading_en: Mark and the driver chat about the traffic jam

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 师傅，我去大使馆，你是不是走错了？
lines.pinyin: Shīfu, wǒ qù dàshǐguǎn, nǐ shì bu shì zǒucuò le?
lines.en: Sir, I'm going to the embassy — did you make a wrong turn?

lines.speaker: 师傅
lines.zh: 现在是上班时间，前面有点儿堵车，我们走另外一条路，距离差不多。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài shì shàng bān shíjiān, qiánmiàn yǒudiǎnr dǔ chē, wǒmen zǒu lìngwài yì tiáo lù, jùlí chàbuduō.
lines.en: It's rush hour right now, and there's a bit of a jam up ahead, so we're taking a different road — the distance is about the same.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 那就好，堵车浪费时间，遇到堵车，心情也"堵"。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù hǎo, dǔ chē làngfèi shíjiān, yùdào dǔ chē, xīnqíng yě "dǔ".
lines.en: That's good then. Traffic jams waste time — when you hit a jam, your mood gets "jammed" too.

lines.speaker: 师傅
lines.zh: 可不是！上班堵车怕迟到，下班堵车怕回家晚。每天在马路上开车，要想不遇到堵车，还真难。
lines.pinyin: Kěbúshì! Shàng bān dǔ chē pà chídào, xià bān dǔ chē pà huí jiā wǎn. Měi tiān zài mǎlù shang kāi chē, yào xiǎng bú yùdào dǔ chē, hái zhēn nán.
lines.en: Isn't that the truth! Traffic on the way to work makes you worry about being late, traffic on the way home makes you worry about getting home late. Driving on the road every day, it's really hard to avoid traffic jams.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 一遇到堵车，人们就容易变得没有耐心。长期这样，还会影响脾气甚至性格。但是您的心情为什么这么好呢？
lines.pinyin: Yí yùdào dǔ chē, rénmen jiù róngyì biànde méiyǒu nàixīn. Chángqī zhèyàng, hái huì yǐngxiǎng píqi shènzhì xìnggé. Dànshì nín de xīnqíng wèi shénme zhème hǎo ne?
lines.en: As soon as people run into a traffic jam, they easily become impatient. Over the long run, this can even affect one's temper or personality. But why is your mood so good?

lines.speaker: 师傅
lines.zh: 我们改变不了堵车，但是可以试着改变自己的心情。堵车时正好可以休息一下，还可以听听自己喜欢的音乐。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen gǎibiàn bu liǎo dǔ chē, dànshì kěyǐ shìzhe gǎibiàn zìjǐ de xīnqíng. Dǔ chē shí zhènghǎo kěyǐ xiūxi yíxià, hái kěyǐ tīngting zìjǐ xǐhuan de yīnyuè.
lines.en: We can't change the traffic, but we can try to change our own mood. Being stuck in traffic is actually a good chance to rest a bit, and I can also listen to music I like.

lines.zh: 草绿了，那是生命的颜色；花开了，那是大自然的礼物。
lines.pinyin: Cǎo lǜ le, nà shì shēngmìng de yánsè; huā kāi le, nà shì dàzìrán de lǐwù.
lines.en: The grass turns green — that is the color of life; flowers bloom — that is a gift from nature.

lines.zh: 生活中不缺少美，缺少的是发现美的眼睛。
lines.pinyin: Shēnghuó zhōng bù quēshǎo měi, quēshǎo de shì fāxiàn měi de yǎnjing.
lines.en: Life is not short of beauty; what it lacks are eyes that can discover beauty.

lines.zh: 只要有心，生活中的美到处都是。
lines.pinyin: Zhǐyào yǒuxīn, shēnghuó zhōng de měi dàochù dōu shì.
lines.en: As long as you set your mind to it, beauty is everywhere in life.

lines.zh: 生活的态度要自己选择，因此，遇到烦恼时，你应该想一些办法让自己从不高兴的心情中走出来。
lines.pinyin: Shēnghuó de tàidù yào zìjǐ xuǎnzé, yīncǐ, yùdào fánnǎo shí, nǐ yīnggāi xiǎng yìxiē bànfǎ ràng zìjǐ cóng bù gāoxìng de xīnqíng zhōng zǒu chulai.
lines.en: You have to choose your own attitude toward life; therefore, when you run into troubles, you should think of ways to pull yourself out of an unhappy mood.

lines.zh: 窗外是什么样子，我们无法改变，但我们可以选择站在哪个窗户前。
lines.pinyin: Chuāng wài shì shénme yàngzi, wǒmen wúfǎ gǎibiàn, dàn wǒmen kěyǐ xuǎnzé zhàn zài nǎ ge chuānghu qián.
lines.en: We cannot change what it looks like outside the window, but we can choose which window to stand in front of.

lines.zh: 选择一个能够带给我们快乐的窗户，这样才能选对心情，选对生活的态度。
lines.pinyin: Xuǎnzé yí ge nénggòu dàigěi wǒmen kuàilè de chuānghu, zhèyàng cái néng xuǎnduì xīnqíng, xuǎnduì shēnghuó de tàidù.
lines.en: Choose a window that can bring us happiness — only then can you get the mood right, and get the attitude toward life right.

lines.zh: 科学研究证明，女孩子对衣服颜色的选择往往与她们的性格有关。
lines.pinyin: Kēxué yánjiū zhèngmíng, nǚháizi duì yīfu yánsè de xuǎnzé wǎngwǎng yǔ tāmen de xìnggé yǒuguān.
lines.en: Scientific research shows that girls' choice of clothing color is often related to their personality.

lines.zh: 喜欢穿白色衣服的女孩子性格比较阳光，生活态度积极向上是她们的共同特点；而喜欢穿红色衣服的女孩子性格比较浪漫。
lines.pinyin: Xǐhuan chuān báisè yīfu de nǚháizi xìnggé bǐjiào yángguāng, shēnghuó tàidù jījí xiàngshàng shì tāmen de gòngtóng tèdiǎn; ér xǐhuan chuān hóngsè yīfu de nǚháizi xìnggé bǐjiào làngmàn.
lines.en: Girls who like wearing white tend to have a sunny, optimistic personality — a positive, forward-looking attitude toward life is their common trait; girls who like wearing red, on the other hand, tend to have a more romantic personality.

lines.zh: 颜色也会影响人的心情，不同的颜色会给我们带来不同的感情变化。
lines.pinyin: Yánsè yě huì yǐngxiǎng rén de xīnqíng, bù tóng de yánsè huì gěi wǒmen dàilái bù tóng de gǎnqíng biànhuà.
lines.en: Color can also affect a person's mood; different colors bring us different emotional changes.

lines.zh: 红色让人变得热情；黄色和白色让人心情愉快；黑色却容易让人感到伤心；人们在看到蓝色时会觉得很舒服，变得安静下来；绿色让我们的眼睛得到休息。
lines.pinyin: Hóngsè ràng rén biànde rèqíng; huángsè hé báisè ràng rén xīnqíng yúkuài; hēisè què róngyì ràng rén gǎndào shāng xīn; rénmen zài kàndào lánsè shí huì juéde hěn shūfu, biànde ānjìng xialai; lǜsè ràng wǒmen de yǎnjing dédào xiūxi.
lines.en: Red makes people become passionate; yellow and white make people feel cheerful; black, however, easily makes people feel sad; when people see blue they feel very comfortable and become calm; green lets our eyes rest.

vocab.en: to call to mind, to recall
a polite title for one with accomplished skills in a trade or handicraft

grammar.explanation: "使", verb, means "to make, to cause", similar to "让"; it is usually used in written Chinese. / "使"，动词，表示"让"的意思，常用在书面语中。

examples.zh: 她看都没看过我一眼，怎么样才能使她喜欢我呢？
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn dōu méi kànguo wǒ yì yǎn, zěnmeyàng cái néng shǐ tā xǐhuan wǒ ne?
examples.en: She hasn't even glanced at me once — how can I make her like me?

examples.zh: 在中国生活的三年使他在音乐方面有了很多新的想法。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó shēnghuó de sān nián shǐ tā zài yīnyuè fāngmiàn yǒule hěn duō xīn de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.en: The three years he lived in China gave him a lot of new ideas about music.

examples.zh: 听说伤心难过的时候吃块儿巧克力，还能使人的心情变得愉快。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō shāng xīn nánguò de shíhou chī kuàir qiǎokèlì, hái néng shǐ rén de xīnqíng biàn de yúkuài.
examples.en: I've heard that eating a piece of chocolate when you're sad can even make a person's mood turn cheerful.

grammar.explanation: The conjunction "只要" is often used in the structure "只要……就……", with the clause after "只要" stating an essential condition and the clause after "就" indicating the result of this condition. / "只要"，连词，常用"只要……就……"结构。"只要"后面的句子提出一个必要的条件，"就"后面的句子表示这个条件所产生的结果。

examples.zh: 只要这次你好好儿准备，一定能把比赛踢好。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào zhè cì nǐ hǎohāor zhǔnbèi, yídìng néng bǎ bǐsài tīhǎo.
examples.en: As long as you prepare well this time, you'll definitely be able to play the match well.

examples.zh: 只要你用心就会发现，身边有那么多有意思的事情，有那么多不一样的生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ yòngxīn jiù huì fāxiàn, shēnbiān yǒu nàme duō yǒu yìsi de shìqing, yǒu nàme duō bù yíyàng de shēnghuó.
examples.en: As long as you put your mind to it, you'll discover that there are so many interesting things around you, so many different ways of living.

examples.zh: 每个人对幸福有不同的理解，对我来说，只要能做自己喜欢的事，就是幸福。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén duì xìngfú yǒu bùtóng de lǐjiě, duì wǒ láishuō, zhǐyào néng zuò zìjǐ xǐhuan de shì, jiùshì xìngfú.
examples.en: Everyone has a different understanding of happiness; for me, as long as I can do what I like, that is happiness.

grammar.explanation: The adverb "可不是" is used to agree with or echo what the other party has said. It is often used alone as a sentence. "可不" can also be used instead. / "可不是"，副词，表示赞同、附和对方说的话，常常单独成句。也说"可不"。

examples.zh: A：没想到咱们毕业都已经十年了。 B：可不是！时间过得太快了，真想大家。
examples.pinyin: A: Méi xiǎngdào zánmen bìyè dōu yǐjīng shí nián le. B: Kěbúshì! Shíjiān guò de tài kuài le, zhēn xiǎng dàjiā.
examples.en: A: I can't believe it's already been ten years since we graduated. B: Isn't that the truth! Time has passed so quickly — I really miss everyone.

examples.zh: A：遇到堵车，心情也"堵"。 B：可不是！上班堵车怕迟到，下班堵车怕回家晚。
examples.pinyin: A: Yùdào dǔ chē, xīnqíng yě "dǔ". B: Kěbúshì! Shàng bān dǔ chē pà chídào, xià bān dǔ chē pà huí jiā wǎn.
examples.en: A: When you hit traffic, your mood gets "jammed" too. B: Isn't that the truth! Traffic on the way to work makes you worry about being late, traffic on the way home makes you worry about getting home late.

examples.zh: A：这家网球馆的服务不错，给我的印象很好。 B：可不是！这儿不仅环境好，还免费提供吃的和水，打球打累的时候，可以吃点儿东西休息一下。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhè jiā wǎngqiúguǎn de fúwù búcuò, gěi wǒ de yìnxiàng hěn hǎo. B: Kěbúshì! Zhèr bùjǐn huánjìng hǎo, hái miǎnfèi tígōng chī de hé shuǐ, dǎqiú dǎ lèi de shíhou, kěyǐ chī diǎnr dōngxi xiūxi yíxià.
examples.en: A: The service at this tennis center is quite good — it left me with a great impression. B: Isn't that the truth! Not only is the environment nice here, they also give out free food and water — when you're tired from playing, you can grab a bite and rest a little.

grammar.explanation: The conjunction "因此" means "because of this", similar to "所以 (so, therefore)", but it cannot be used together with "因为". / "因此"，连词，表示"因为这个"的意思，和"所以"的意思差不多，但不能和"因为"搭配使用。

examples.zh: 我认识他很多年，因此，很了解他的性格。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènshi tā hěn duō nián, yīncǐ, hěn liǎojiě tā de xìnggé.
examples.en: I've known him for many years, so I understand his personality well.

examples.zh: 每个学生的性格、能力不同，因此，老师要根据学生的特点，用不同的方法。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge xuésheng de xìnggé, nénglì bùtóng, yīncǐ, lǎoshī yào gēnjù xuésheng de tèdiǎn, yòng bùtóng de fāngfǎ.
examples.en: Every student's personality and ability are different; therefore, teachers need to use different methods based on each student's characteristics.

examples.zh: 生活的态度要自己选择，因此，遇到烦恼时，你应该想一些办法让自己从不高兴的心情中走出来。
examples.pinyin: Shēnghuó de tàidù yào zìjǐ xuǎnzé, yīncǐ, yùdào fánnǎo shí, nǐ yīnggāi xiǎng yìxiē bànfǎ ràng zìjǐ cóng bù gāoxìng de xīnqíng zhōng zǒu chulai.
examples.en: You have to choose your own attitude toward life; therefore, when you run into troubles, you should think of ways to pull yourself out of an unhappy mood.

grammar.explanation: The adverb "往往" indicates that a certain situation frequently happens under specific circumstances, based on past experience; it is usually used to talk about things that are somewhat regular. / "往往"，副词，表示根据过去的经验，某种情况在一定条件下经常发生，常用来说明有一定规律性的事情。

examples.zh: 女孩子对衣服颜色的选择往往与她们的性格有关。
examples.pinyin: Nǚháizi duì yīfu yánsè de xuǎnzé wǎngwǎng yǔ tāmen de xìnggé yǒuguān.
examples.en: Girls' choice of clothing color is often related to their personality.

examples.zh: 有经验的出租车司机往往对道路情况都非常熟悉，他们知道一天的每个时段什么地方可能堵车。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu jīngyàn de chūzū chē sījī wǎngwǎng duì dàolù qíngkuàng dōu fēicháng shúxī, tāmen zhīdào yì tiān de měi ge shíduàn shénme dìfang kěnéng dǔ chē.
examples.en: Experienced taxi drivers are usually very familiar with road conditions; they know where traffic jams are likely to occur at each time of day.

examples.zh: 除了正式的名字，中国人一般都有个小名。在家里，父母往往只叫孩子的小名。
examples.pinyin: Chúle zhèngshì de míngzi, Zhōngguórén yìbān dōu yǒu ge xiǎomíng. Zài jiā li, fùmǔ wǎngwǎng zhǐ jiào háizi de xiǎomíng.
examples.en: Besides their formal name, Chinese people generally also have a pet name. At home, parents often call their child only by their pet name.

compare.note:
Similarity 相同点: Both can be used as adverbs, indicating a situation occurring repeatedly (marked ★). Example: 要是缺少调查、不听别人说明情况，不理解往往/经常就可能发生。(If you lack investigation and don't listen to others explain the situation, misunderstanding can often/frequently occur.)

Differences 不同点:
1. In case ★, "往往" is a summary of the situation up to the present, showing a certain regularity, and is not used for subjective wishes — so it can only describe things that have already happened. "经常" only indicates that an action occurs many times, not necessarily with any regularity; it can express subjective wishes, so it can describe things that have not yet happened but may occur repeatedly. Examples: 吃完晚饭，他们一家往往去附近的公园散散步。(After dinner, their family often goes for a walk in the nearby park — an established habit.) 长时间对着电脑工作对身体不好，我们以后也经常去公园散散步吧。(Working at the computer for long periods isn't good for your health — let's start often going for walks in the park too. Only 经常 works here, since it's a future wish.)
2. In case ★, sentences with "往往" usually specify the situation, condition, or result related to the action; sentences with "经常" have no such restriction. Examples: 上大学时我很喜欢运动，往往/经常在周末打篮球、踢足球。(In college I loved sports, and often played basketball and soccer on weekends — both words work because "on weekends" specifies the condition.) 上大学时我很喜欢运动，经常打篮球、踢足球。(In college I loved sports, and often played basketball and soccer — only 经常 works, since no condition is specified.)
3. "经常" is usually equivalent to "常"; "往往" cannot be shortened to "往". Example: 在商家打折的时候，有的人（经）常会买一些自己本来不需要，甚至很可能一直都用不到的东西。(When stores have sales, some people often buy things they don't actually need, and may even never use.)

examples.zh: 年轻人最重要的是要对自己有信心。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén zuì zhòngyào de shì yào duì zìjǐ yǒu xìnxīn.
examples.en: The most important thing for young people is to have confidence in themselves.

examples.zh: 这本书主要介绍了中国的文化和历史。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhǔyào jièshàole Zhōngguó de wénhuà hé lìshǐ.
examples.en: This book mainly introduces Chinese culture and history.

examples.zh: 只要你打开电视，总能看到那么多的广告，真是浪费时间。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ dǎkāi diànshì, zǒng néng kàndào nàme duō de guǎnggào, zhēnshi làngfèi shíjiān.
examples.en: As soon as you turn on the TV, you always see so many ads — it's really a waste of time.

examples.zh: 那个电视节目特别有意思，你要是有时间也看看吧。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge diànshì jiémù tèbié yǒu yìsi, nǐ yàoshi yǒu shíjiān yě kànkan ba.
examples.en: That TV program is really interesting; if you have time, you should watch it too.

culture.title_en: Red and White in Chinese People's Eyes
culture.summary: The colors red and white have different connotations in Chinese and Western cultures. The Chinese love red because in their culture, it symbolizes good luck and festivity, meaning life is "(as good and prosperous) as the red fire". When people get married, red is seen everywhere in their homes, which is why weddings are called the "red events". White, on the other hand, symbolizes sorrow and death besides cleanness and purity. When white flowers and cloth are seen all over a house, it means the "white event (funeral)" is going on in the house, where someone must have died.

exercises: 练习1 复述 Retell the dialogues, starting from the given phrase: 课文1 (高老师的语气 in Teacher Gao's voice): 这是我女儿从国外带回来的巧克力，…… 课文2 (小夏的语气 in Xiao Xia's voice): 这段时间我一直在回忆那次比赛，…… 课文3 (出租车司机的语气 in the taxi driver's voice): 前面有点儿堵车，……

练习2 选择合适的词语填空 Choose the proper words to fill in the blanks. Word bank: 伤心 放松 只要 积极 证明. ①有的人认为，心情____、身体健康才是真正的幸福。 ②她听到这个消息后____地哭了。 ③这次招聘会提供了差不多1000个工作机会，请同学们____参加。 ④很多小孩子觉得所有东西____一哭就能得到。 ⑤他现在已经成为一个有名的律师，终于向所有人____自己的选择是对的。

练习2 (续) Word bank: 耐心 愉快 到处 缺少 发生. ⑥A：终于爬上来了，累死我了，这山太高了！ B：看来你真的是____锻炼，以后每天跟我一块儿跑步吧。 ⑦A：你今天的面试怎么样？ B：经理说会认真考虑一下，让我别着急，____等消息。 ⑧A：不管遇到什么问题、____什么事情，都不要着急。 B：谢谢您的关心，我记住了。 ⑨A：你喜欢听什么样的歌？ B：我喜欢那些比较慢，听着让人感觉很浪漫，心情____的歌。 ⑩A：你的东西怎么____乱放呢？快去打扫一下！ B：知道了，我一会儿就去。

运用1 双人活动 Pair Work: 互相了解对方关于颜色的想法，完成调查表 (Learn about each other's ideas of colors and complete the questionnaire). 问 (Questions): 1 你什么颜色的衣服最多？ 2 你最喜欢什么颜色？为什么？ 3 你最不喜欢什么颜色？为什么？ 4 你觉得你的生活是什么"颜色"的？为什么？ 5 你认为一年四季是什么"颜色"的？为什么？ 6 如果世界上只能有一种颜色，你希望是哪种？ (答 answer column left blank for students)

texts.label: 课文1
texts.heading_zh: 王静和孙月聊孙月减肥的事情
texts.heading_en: Wang Jing and Sun Yue talk about Sun Yue's diet

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 怎么又买了这么多饼干和巧克力？难道你不减肥了？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme yòu mǎile zhème duō bǐnggān hé qiǎokèlì? Nándào nǐ bù jiǎnféi le?
lines.en: Why did you buy so many biscuits and chocolate again? Don't tell me you're not dieting anymore?

lines.speaker: 孙月
lines.zh: 减了一个月都没瘦下来，我实在没有信心了。
lines.pinyin: Jiǎnle yí ge yuè dōu méi shòu xialai, wǒ shízài méiyǒu xìnxīn le.
lines.en: I've been dieting for a month and haven't lost any weight at all — I really don't have any confidence left.

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 如果你想减肥，就得少吃东西，而且要多运动。
lines.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng jiǎnféi, jiù děi shǎo chī dōngxi, érqiě yào duō yùndòng.
lines.en: If you want to lose weight, you have to eat less, and you also need to exercise more.

lines.speaker: 孙月
lines.zh: 我就是这么做的，但这一个月下来，我只轻了一公斤。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiù shì zhème zuò de, dàn zhè yí ge yuè xialai, wǒ zhǐ qīngle yì gōngjīn.
lines.en: That's exactly what I've been doing, but over this whole month, I've only lost one kilogram.

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 一个月太短了。要想减肥成功，只能坚持，才会慢慢有效果。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge yuè tài duǎn le. Yào xiǎng jiǎnféi chénggōng, zhǐ néng jiānchí, cái huì mànmàn yǒu xiàoguǒ.
lines.en: One month is too short. If you want to lose weight successfully, you just have to stick with it — only then will you gradually see results.

lines.speaker: 孙月
lines.zh: 我本来已经打算放弃了，但是你刚才的话让我改变了主意。这些饼干和巧克力送给你了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yǐjīng dǎsuàn fàngqì le, dànshì nǐ gāngcái de huà ràng wǒ gǎibiànle zhǔyi. Zhèxiē bǐnggān hé qiǎokèlì sònggěi nǐ le.
lines.en: I had already planned to give up, but what you just said changed my mind. These biscuits and chocolate are yours now.

texts.label: 课文2
texts.heading_zh: 李进和张远聊张远的成功经历
texts.heading_en: Li Jin and Zhang Yuan talk about Zhang Yuan's path to success

lines.speaker: 李进
lines.zh: 你网球打得真好，还得过那么多国际大奖！每次看你比赛，感觉你轻轻松松就赢了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ wǎngqiú dǎ de zhēn hǎo, hái déguo nàme duō guójì dà jiǎng! Měi cì kàn nǐ bǐsài, gǎnjué nǐ qīngqīngsōngsōng jiù yíng le.
lines.en: You play tennis so well, and you've even won so many international awards! Every time I watch you compete, it feels like you win effortlessly.

lines.speaker: 张远
lines.zh: 哪里啊！那是你没看到我辛苦练习的一面，没有人随随便便就能成功的。
lines.pinyin: Nǎli a! Nà shì nǐ méi kàndào wǒ xīnkǔ liànxí de yí miàn, méiyǒu rén suísuíbiànbiàn jiù néng chénggōng de.
lines.en: Not at all! That's just because you haven't seen how hard I practice — nobody can succeed effortlessly, without trying.

lines.speaker: 李进
lines.zh: 我从小也对网球感兴趣，但是到现在还是打得不怎么样。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo yě duì wǎngqiú gǎn xìngqù, dànshì dào xiànzài hái shì dǎ de bù zěnmeyàng.
lines.en: I've also been interested in tennis since I was a kid, but even now I still don't play very well.

lines.speaker: 张远
lines.zh: 你知道吗？不管春夏秋冬，我练球从来没有休息过一天。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào ma? Bùguǎn chūn xià qiū dōng, wǒ liàn qiú cónglái méiyǒu xiūxiguo yì tiān.
lines.en: You know what? No matter the season — spring, summer, fall, or winter — I've never taken a single day off from practicing.

lines.speaker: 李进
lines.zh: 真是不容易啊！看来我只看到了你成功时获得的鲜花，却没注意到你成功前流下的汗水。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn shì bù róngyì a! Kànlái wǒ zhǐ kàndàole nǐ chénggōng shí huòdé de xiānhuā, què méi zhùyì dào nǐ chénggōng qián liúxia de hànshuǐ.
lines.en: That's really not easy! It seems I only ever saw the flowers you received when you succeeded, but never noticed the sweat you shed before that success.

lines.speaker: 张远
lines.zh: 任何成功都要通过努力才能得到。只要你坚持练习，我相信你也会越打越好的。
lines.pinyin: Rènhé chénggōng dōu yào tōngguò nǔlì cái néng dédào. Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí liànxí, wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ yě huì yuè dǎ yuè hǎo de.
lines.en: Any success can only be achieved through hard work. As long as you keep practicing, I'm sure you'll keep getting better too.

texts.label: 课文3
texts.heading_zh: 小林和小李谈王红的成功经历
texts.heading_en: Xiao Lin and Xiao Li talk about Wang Hong's path to success

lines.speaker: 小林
lines.zh: 你还记得王红吗？我在报纸上看到一篇关于她的新闻，她现在已经是一个有名的作家了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hái jìde Wáng Hóng ma? Wǒ zài bàozhǐ shang kàndào yì piān guānyú tā de xīnwén, tā xiànzài yǐjīng shì yí ge yǒumíng de zuòjiā le.
lines.en: Do you still remember Wang Hong? I saw an article about her in the newspaper — she's already a famous writer now.

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.zh: 听说她毕业后放弃了律师的工作，开始专门写小说，没想到她竟然成功了。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō tā bìyè hòu fàngqìle lǜshī de gōngzuò, kāishǐ zhuānmén xiě xiǎoshuō, méi xiǎngdào tā jìngrán chénggōng le.
lines.en: I heard that after graduating she gave up her job as a lawyer and started writing novels full-time — I never expected she'd actually succeed.

lines.speaker: 小林
lines.zh: 当时她的父母和亲戚都不支持她，可是她坚持自己的选择，现在终于向所有人证明了她的选择是正确的。
lines.pinyin: Dāngshí tā de fùmǔ hé qīnqi dōu bù zhīchí tā, kěshì tā jiānchí zìjǐ de xuǎnzé, xiànzài zhōngyú xiàng suǒyǒu rén zhèngmíngle tā de xuǎnzé shì zhèngquè de.
lines.en: At the time, her parents and relatives didn't support her, but she stuck to her own choice, and now she's finally proven to everyone that her choice was right.

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.zh: 看来为了自己的理想，放弃一些东西也是值得的。
lines.pinyin: Kànlái wèile zìjǐ de lǐxiǎng, fàngqì yìxiē dōngxi yě shì zhídé de.
lines.en: It seems that giving up some things for the sake of your own ideals is worth it after all.

lines.speaker: 小林
lines.zh: 一个人只有两只手，不可能得到所有想要的东西，所以有时候放弃是一种聪明的选择。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge rén zhǐyǒu liǎng zhī shǒu, bù kěnéng dédào suǒyǒu xiǎng yào de dōngxi, suǒyǐ yǒu shíhou fàngqì shì yì zhǒng cōngming de xuǎnzé.
lines.en: A person only has two hands — you can't possibly get everything you want, so sometimes giving up is actually a smart choice.

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.zh: 是啊，只有学会放弃，才能把自己的能力用到最该做的事情上，最后获得成功。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, zhǐyǒu xuéhuì fàngqì, cái néng bǎ zìjǐ de nénglì yòngdào zuì gāi zuò de shìqing shang, zuìhòu huòdé chénggōng.
lines.en: Right, only by learning to let go can you put your abilities toward what you really should be doing, and ultimately achieve success.

lines.zh: 如果你想做什么事情，那就勇敢地去做，不要担心结果，不要考虑会不会失败。
lines.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme shìqing, nà jiù yǒnggǎn de qù zuò, búyào dān xīn jiéguǒ, búyào kǎolǜ huì bu huì shībài.
lines.en: If you want to do something, then go ahead and do it bravely — don't worry about the outcome, and don't think about whether you'll fail or not.

lines.zh: 要是太看重结果，失败就会给人们带来很多烦恼。
lines.pinyin: Yàoshi tài kànzhòng jiéguǒ, shībài jiù huì gěi rénmen dàilai hěn duō fánnǎo.
lines.en: If you place too much importance on the outcome, failure will bring people a lot of distress.

lines.zh: 我们应该把注意力放在做事情的过程上，这样你会在做的过程中发现解决问题的快乐，这是其他任何东西都给不了的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi bǎ zhùyìlì fàng zài zuò shìqing de guòchéng shang, zhèyàng nǐ huì zài zuò de guòchéng zhōng fāxiàn jiějué wèntí de kuàilè, zhè shì qítā rènhé dōngxi dōu gěi bu liǎo de.
lines.en: We should focus our attention on the process of doing things — that way you'll discover the joy of solving problems during the process, and that's something nothing else can give you.

lines.zh: 即使最后失败了也没有关系，因为至少你已经努力过，而且我们还可以从失败中总结出有用的经验，有了这些积累，成功自然离我们越来越近。
lines.pinyin: Jíshǐ zuìhòu shībàile yě méiyǒu guānxi, yīnwèi zhìshǎo nǐ yǐjīng nǔlìguo, érqiě wǒmen hái kěyǐ cóng shībài zhōng zǒngjié chū yǒuyòng de jīngyàn, yǒule zhèxiē jīlěi, chénggōng zìrán lí wǒmen yuè lái yuè jìn.
lines.en: Even if you fail in the end, it's fine, because at least you've tried, and moreover we can sum up useful experience from failure — with that accumulation, success naturally gets closer and closer to us.

lines.zh: 每一个人都希望成功，可是很多时候，在成功之前会遇到很多困难。
lines.pinyin: Měi yí ge rén dōu xīwàng chénggōng, kěshì hěn duō shíhou, zài chénggōng zhīqián huì yùdào hěn duō kùnnan.
lines.en: Everyone hopes to succeed, but a lot of the time, before you succeed you'll run into many difficulties.

lines.zh: 有些人遇到困难就放弃，而有些人遇到困难却想办法解决它。
lines.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén yùdào kùnnan jiù fàngqì, ér yǒuxiē rén yùdào kùnnan què xiǎng bànfǎ jiějué tā.
lines.en: Some people give up as soon as they hit a difficulty, while others try to find a way to solve it instead.

lines.zh: 对困难的态度不同，结果也是不一样的。
lines.pinyin: Duì kùnnan de tàidù bù tóng, jiéguǒ yě shì bù yíyàng de.
lines.en: Different attitudes toward difficulty lead to different results.

lines.zh: 爱迪生就是在找了上千种材料后才找到了能点亮电灯的材料。
lines.pinyin: Àidíshēng jiù shì zài zhǎole shàng qiān zhǒng cáiliào hòu cái zhǎodàole néng diǎnliàng diàndēng de cáiliào.
lines.en: Edison, for example, only found the material that could light up the electric lamp after searching through over a thousand kinds of materials.

lines.zh: 取得成功的人往往都经历过许多失败，他们和普通人的区别就是他们都坚持了下来。
lines.pinyin: Qǔdé chénggōng de rén wǎngwǎng dōu jīnglìguo xǔduō shībài, tāmen hé pǔtōng rén de qūbié jiù shì tāmen dōu jiānchíle xialai.
lines.en: People who achieve success have usually gone through many failures; the difference between them and ordinary people is simply that they kept persisting.

lines.zh: 所以就算只有1%的希望，我们也要做出100%的努力。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ jiù suàn zhǐyǒu bǎi fēn zhī yī de xīwàng, wǒmen yě yào zuòchū bǎi fēn zhī bǎi de nǔlì.
lines.en: So even if there's only a 1% chance, we still need to put in 100% effort.

lines.zh: 困难只是暂时的，“阳光总在风雨后”，只有我们勇敢地面对困难，才能有希望取得成功。
lines.pinyin: Kùnnan zhǐ shì zànshí de, “Yángguāng zǒng zài fēngyǔ hòu”, zhǐyǒu wǒmen yǒnggǎn de miànduì kùnnan, cái néng yǒu xīwàng qǔdé chénggōng.
lines.en: Difficulty is only temporary — “the sun will shine again after the storm” — only by bravely facing our difficulties can we have any hope of achieving success.

vocab.en: used in a rhetorical question for emphasis
used for writings, papers or articles
Wang Hong, name of a person
Thomas Alva Edison (1847-1931), an American inventor

grammar.explanation: “难道” is an adverb that strengthens the tone of a rhetorical question. Used in a positive rhetorical question it indicates a negative meaning; used in a negative rhetorical question it indicates a positive meaning. E.g. “难道汉语真的这么难吗？” (Is Chinese really that difficult?) emphasizes that the speaker thinks Chinese is NOT difficult.

examples.zh: 怎么又买了这么多饼干和巧克力？难道你不减肥了？
examples.pinyin: Zěnme yòu mǎile zhème duō bǐnggān hé qiǎokèlì? Nándào nǐ bù jiǎnféi le?
examples.en: Why did you buy so many biscuits and chocolate again? Don't tell me you're not dieting anymore?

examples.zh: A：喂，都十点了，你怎么还不来？ B：难道你没看短信？我今天有事去不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wéi, dōu shí diǎn le, nǐ zěnme hái bù lái? B: Nándào nǐ méi kàn duǎnxìn? Wǒ jīntiān yǒu shì qù bu liǎo le.
examples.en: A: "Hey, it's already ten o'clock, why haven't you come yet?" B: "Didn't you see the text message? I have something on today, so I can't make it."

examples.zh: A：你不是两点就出发了吗？难道路上花了两个多小时？ B：我那辆车出了点儿问题，刚才把车送去修了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ bú shì liǎng diǎn jiù chūfā le ma? Nándào lùshang huāle liǎng ge duō xiǎoshí? B: Wǒ nà liàng chē chūle diǎnr wèntí, gāngcái bǎ chē sòngqù xiū le.
examples.en: A: "Didn't you leave at two o'clock? Don't tell me it took you more than two hours on the way?" B: "There was a bit of a problem with my car — I just took it in to get fixed."

grammar.explanation: As a preposition, “通过” means the attainment of a certain result via somebody or by means of something. As a verb, “通过” can also mean to pass through some place from one end (side) to another end (side); it can further mean to have reached a certain standard or met a certain requirement.

examples.zh: 任何成功都要通过努力才能得到。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé chénggōng dōu yào tōngguò nǔlì cái néng dédào.
examples.en: Any success can only be achieved through hard work.

examples.zh: 这个节目我一直在看，它介绍了很多生活中的小知识。很多以前我没有注意到的问题，现在通过它了解了不少。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiémù wǒ yìzhí zài kàn, tā jièshàole hěn duō shēnghuó zhōng de xiǎo zhīshi. Hěn duō yǐqián wǒ méiyǒu zhùyì dào de wèntí, xiànzài tōngguò tā liǎojiěle bù shǎo.
examples.en: I've been watching this program all along — it introduces lots of little everyday facts. Many issues I hadn't noticed before, I now understand quite a bit of them through it.

examples.zh: 这条街只能步行通过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē zhǐ néng bùxíng tōngguò.
examples.en: This street can only be passed through on foot.

examples.zh: 我通过那家公司的面试了。经理对我印象不错，他要我明天就正式去上班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tōngguòle nà jiā gōngsī de miànshì le. Jīnglǐ duì wǒ yìnxiàng búcuò, tā yào wǒ míngtiān jiù zhèngshì qù shàngbān.
examples.en: I passed that company's interview. The manager had a good impression of me, and he wants me to officially start work tomorrow.

grammar.explanation: “可是” is a conjunction used in the second clause of a complex sentence to indicate a transition in meaning; the earlier clause is often introduced with “虽然” (although).

examples.zh: A：你怎么又想换工作了，这儿的收入不是挺高的吗？ B：虽然收入高，可是经常要加班，很少有时间和家人在一起。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme yòu xiǎng huàn gōngzuò le, zhèr de shōurù bú shì tǐng gāo de ma? B: Suīrán shōurù gāo, kěshì jīngcháng yào jiābān, hěn shǎo yǒu shíjiān hé jiārén zài yìqǐ.
examples.en: A: "Why do you want to change jobs again? Isn't the pay here pretty good?" B: "Although the pay is high, I often have to work overtime, so I rarely have time with my family."

examples.zh: 小时候，大家都说我像我妈，尤其是性格。可是长大后，他们说我更像爸爸。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou, dàjiā dōu shuō wǒ xiàng wǒ mā, yóuqí shì xìnggé. Kěshì zhǎngdà hòu, tāmen shuō wǒ gèng xiàng bàba.
examples.en: When I was little, everyone said I resembled my mom, especially in personality. But after I grew up, they said I looked more like my dad.

examples.zh: 当时她的父母和亲戚都不支持她，可是她坚持自己的选择，现在终于向所有人证明了她的选择是正确的。
examples.pinyin: Dāngshí tā de fùmǔ hé qīnqi dōu bù zhīchí tā, kěshì tā jiānchí zìjǐ de xuǎnzé, xiànzài zhōngyú xiàng suǒyǒu rén zhèngmíngle tā de xuǎnzé shì zhèngquè de.
examples.en: At the time, her parents and relatives didn't support her, but she stuck to her own choice, and now she's finally proven to everyone that her choice was right.

grammar.explanation: As a noun, “结果” indicates the final state that something has developed into. As a conjunction, “结果” indicates a cause-and-effect relationship, usually appearing in the second clause of a complex sentence to introduce the eventual outcome of the situation described in the first clause.

examples.zh: 小张，你这份计划书写得不错，就按照这个计划去做市场调查吧。下个月把调查结果交上来。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng, nǐ zhè fèn jìhuàshū xiě de búcuò, jiù ànzhào zhège jìhuà qù zuò shìchǎng diàochá ba. Xià ge yuè bǎ diàochá jiéguǒ jiāo shànglai.
examples.en: Xiao Zhang, this proposal you wrote is quite good — go ahead and do the market research according to this plan. Hand in the research results next month.

examples.zh: 如果你想做什么事情，那就勇敢地去做，不要担心结果，不要考虑会不会失败。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme shìqing, nà jiù yǒnggǎn de qù zuò, búyào dān xīn jiéguǒ, búyào kǎolǜ huì bu huì shībài.
examples.en: If you want to do something, then go ahead and do it bravely — don't worry about the outcome, don't think about whether you'll fail or not.

examples.zh: 我妻子想减肥，所以她每天早上都去骑马。结果马竟然在一个月之内瘦了二十斤。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qīzi xiǎng jiǎnféi, suǒyǐ tā měitiān zǎoshang dōu qù qí mǎ. Jiéguǒ mǎ jìngrán zài yí ge yuè zhīnèi shòule èrshí jīn.
examples.en: My wife wanted to lose weight, so she went horseback riding every morning. As it turned out, it was the horse that ended up losing twenty jin in a month!

examples.zh: 有些人爱说“差不多”。例如，每天的工作都是完成得差不多，结果，积累下来，就变成差很多了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén ài shuō “chàbuduō”. Lìrú, měitiān de gōngzuò dōu shì wánchéng de chàbuduō, jiéguǒ, jīlěi xiàlai, jiù biànchéng chà hěn duō le.
examples.en: Some people like to say "close enough." For example, if every day's work only ever gets "almost" finished, then over time that adds up to a big shortfall.

grammar.explanation: The verb “上” means to achieve or reach (a certain quantity or degree), and is often followed by an object indicating quantity.

examples.zh: 这个城市的地铁已经有上百年的历史了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de dìtiě yǐjīng yǒu shàng bǎi nián de lìshǐ le.
examples.en: This city's subway already has a history of over a hundred years.

examples.zh: 每年有成千上万的高中毕业生参加艺术考试。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián yǒu chéngqiān-shàngwàn de gāozhōng bìyèshēng cānjiā yìshù kǎoshì.
examples.en: Every year, tens of thousands of high school graduates take art exams.

examples.zh: 爱迪生就是在找了上千种材料后才找到了能点亮电灯的材料。
examples.pinyin: Àidíshēng jiù shì zài zhǎole shàng qiān zhǒng cáiliào hòu cái zhǎodàole néng diǎnliàng diàndēng de cáiliào.
examples.en: Edison only found the material that could light up the electric lamp after searching through over a thousand kinds of materials.

compare.note: 相同点 Similarity: 两者都可表示把人或事物作为某种手段而达到某种目的 (Both can indicate attaining a goal via somebody or by means of something), e.g. 通过/经过大家的努力，公司的生意越做越大 (Tōngguò/jīngguò dàjiā de nǔlì, gōngsī de shēngyi yuè zuò yuè dà — Through everyone's efforts, the company's business kept growing). 不同点 Differences: (1) 表示上述意思时，“通过”是介词，强调方法、手段；“经过”是动词，强调事情的过程 — When expressing that meaning, 通过 is a preposition emphasizing method/means, while 经过 is a verb emphasizing the process. E.g. 希望通过这次活动引起大家的兴趣，让大家更了解我们公司 (We hope to spark everyone's interest through this event, so they get to know our company better) / 经过一次次失败之后，他终于成功了 (After failing again and again, he finally succeeded). (2) 两者做动词时，“通过”表示从某地穿过，从一端/一侧到另一端/另一侧；“经过”表示途经某地，没有穿过的意思 — As verbs, 通过 means to pass all the way through a place from one end/side to the other, while 经过 means to go by way of a place without implying passing through it. E.g. 这里正在修路，汽车无法通过 (The road here is under repair; cars cannot get through) / 我正好经过这儿，顺便过来看看你 (I happened to be passing by here, so I dropped in to see you). (3) “经过”还可以做名词，表示事情发展的过程；“通过”没有这个用法 — 经过 can also be a noun meaning the course/process of how something developed; 通过 has no such usage. E.g. 小王把事情的经过告诉我了，原来这件事真的跟你没关系 (Xiao Wang told me the whole story of what happened — turns out this really has nothing to do with you).

culture.summary: 中国有句俗话，叫作“千里之行，始于足下”。它告诉我们，要想成功必须从小事做起，并且懂得坚持。世间最容易的事是坚持，最难的事也是坚持。说它容易，是因为只要愿意做，人人能做到；说它难，是因为真正能做到的，终究只是少数人。成功在于坚持，这是一个并不神秘的秘诀。如果在努力的过程中遇到困难，也不要放弃。 // English (as printed): There is a Chinese saying that goes "A journey of a thousand miles begins with the first step". It tells us that in order to become successful, we have to start with minor matters and learn to keep going on. Perseverance is the easiest as well as the hardest thing in the world. It's easy because everybody can make it as long as they are willing to, and it's difficult because only a small minority of us can actually do it. The secret of success lies in perseverance, which is not mysterious at all. Don't give up even if difficulties come up in the process.

exercises: 练习1 复述 Retell the dialogues (sentence starters given): 课文1 孙月的语气: 我今天买了很多饼干和巧克力。……｜课文2 李进的语气: 张远网球打得特别好，……｜课文3 王红的语气: 我毕业后放弃了律师的工作，……

练习2 选择合适的词语填空 Choose the proper words to fill in the blanks. Word bank: 过程 至少 区别 正确 暂时 — ①我住的地方离地铁站有点儿远，走路___要三十分钟。②所有的困难都是___的，要有信心，我相信你一定会成功。③“爱”和“喜欢”有什么___？我认为“爱”比“喜欢”的感情更深。④其实，只要我们真正努力过了，就不需要太关心结果。因为不管最后是成功还是失败，在努力的___中，我们已经学到了很多东西。⑤减肥不只是为了瘦，更是为了健康。___的减肥方法是按时吃饭，多吃水果，多运动，而不是饿肚子。 (Blanks left as printed; no answer key given on the page.)

练习2 (续) Word bank: 汗 得(děi) 取 理想 放弃 — ⑥A: 师傅，麻烦您快点儿行吗？我___在九点之前到大使馆。B: 不用担心，保证按时把您送到。⑦A: 你哥不是说三点到吗？都过去半个小时了，怎么还没出来？B: 他还得去___行李箱，您别担心，我打个电话问。⑧A: 外面热吗？你怎么满头大___？B: 电梯坏了，我爬楼梯上来的。⑨A: 你考虑清楚了？真的要___这次机会？B: 是的，我妈妈身体不太好，我决定留下来照顾她。⑩A: 你研究生考试考得怎么样？B: 数学可能考得不太___。 (Blanks left as printed; no answer key given on the page.)
根据课文内容回答问题 Answer the questions based on the texts — 课文1: ①孙月买了些什么？她为什么不想减肥了？②怎样减肥才能有效果？｜课文2: ③张远的网球为什么打得那么好？④为什么说没有人能随随便便成功？｜课文3: ⑤王红是干什么的？她是怎样获得成功的？⑥为什么说有时候放弃是一种聪明的选择？
根据课文内容回答问题 Answer the questions based on the texts — 课文4: ①过程和结果，哪个更重要？要是太看重结果会怎么样？②为什么说失败了也没关系？｜课文5: ③人们对困难的态度有什么不同？在这一点上，取得成功的人和普通人的区别是什么？④爱迪生是怎样成功发明电灯的？“阳光总在风雨后”是什么意思？

扩展 同字词 果 (如果/结果/效果) example sentences: (1) 现在朋友之间流行发各种幽默短信，这给我们的生活带来一些快乐。但是如果同样的短信你收到了三四遍，再幽默的短信你也笑不出来了。(Rúguǒ tóngyàng de duǎnxìn nǐ shōudàole sān sì biàn, zài yōumò de duǎnxìn nǐ yě xiào bu chūlái le. — If you receive the same joke text three or four times, even the funniest message won't make you laugh anymore.) (2) A: 没有你的帮助，我肯定不能按时完成任务，真是太谢谢你了！B: 你太客气了，我不过是说了一点儿想法，这一切都是你自己辛苦努力的结果。(Zhè yíqiè dōu shì nǐ zìjǐ xīnkǔ nǔlì de jiéguǒ. — All of this is the result of your own hard work.) (3) 尽管很辛苦，但他还是坚持每天做运动，几个月下来，减肥的效果很不错。(Jǐnguǎn hěn xīnkǔ, dàn tā háishi jiānchí měitiān zuò yùndòng, jǐ ge yuè xiàlai, jiǎnféi de xiàoguǒ hěn búcuò. — Even though it was hard, he kept exercising every day; after a few months, the weight-loss results were quite good.)

做一做 Drills (Expansion, 果): 选词填空 Fill in the blanks with 如果/结果/效果 — ①做事情，不要一开始就考虑过多：会不会很难，___会怎么样……这些其实都不重要，关键是要勇敢地去做，只有去做，一切才有可能。②春天天气时冷时热，容易感冒，医生提醒人们要注意室内空气质量，早上起床后应该打开窗户换气。___感冒了，要及时去医院。③水果减肥法是指通过每天只吃水果而不再吃别的东西来减肥的一种方法。这样减肥虽然有一定的___，却很不健康。 (Blanks left as printed; no answer key given on the page.)

做一做 Drills (注释2 通过/经过): 选词填空 Tick or cross table — ①___调查我们发现，客人住宾馆最关心的是干净不干净。(通过 ✓, 经过 ✓ — both marked correct, given as worked example) ②这是保修卡，遇到什么问题，您可以___上面的电话联系我们。(通过 ✓, 经过 ✗ — given as worked example) ③我不了解这件事情的___，你问问其他人吧。(blank, unmarked — for students) ④___这段时间的学习，他的汉语水平提高了不少。(blank, unmarked — for students) ⑤有些人___节食的方法来减肥，虽然有效，但是时间长了对身体没有好处。(blank, unmarked — for students)
运用1 双人活动 Pair Work — 互相了解对方关于成功的看法，完成调查表 (blank questionnaire, questions only): 1对你来说，成功的标准是什么？2你认为怎样才能取得成功？3如果失败了，你打算怎么办？4你做过的最成功的事情是什么？5你眼中成功的人都有谁？6你认为成功的人有哪些好的习惯？

运用2 小组活动 Group Work — “没有人能随随便便成功”，这句话你同意吗？你认为谁是成功的？他是怎么取得成功的？请向小组成员介绍一下他的故事。（请最少用四个下面的结构）Do you agree with the saying "Nobody can succeed effortlessly"? Who do you think is successful? How did they achieve success? Tell your group (use at least four of the structures below): a.从来没有休息过一天 b.成功前留下的汗水 c.通过努力 d.向所有人证明 e.为了自己的理想 f.只有学会放弃 g.不要担心结果 h.阳光总在风雨后
