warmup: Activity 1 (给下面的词语选择对应的图片 / Match the pictures with the words): Six words to match to pictures A-F — ① 兴奋 xīngfèn (excited), ② 硕士 shuòshì (Master's degree), ③ 困 kùn (sleepy), ④ 翻译 fānyì (translator/to translate), ⑤ 拉 lā (to pull), ⑥ 躺 tǎng (to lie down). Pictures: A = a man in cap and gown at graduation; B = a sign reading 'services' in English/French/German/Japanese/Chinese; C = a woman lying on a sofa; D = a man in a suit and hard hat pulling a rope/cart; E = a man yawning at his office desk; F = a group of people jumping joyfully on a beach.

Activity 2 (什么是幸福？/ What is happiness?): A three-column survey table. Column 1 '你认为什么是幸福？' (What do you think happiness is?) with checkbox options 工作好、收入高 (good job, high income), 有很多朋友 (many friends), 家人互相关心 (family caring for each other), 其他 (other). Column 2 '现在你感到幸福吗？' (Do you feel happy now?) with options 很幸福 (very happy), 比较幸福 (fairly happy), 说不清楚 (hard to say), 不幸福 (not happy). Column 3 '什么会影响你的幸福感？' (What affects your sense of happiness?) with options 身体 (health), 工作 (work), 家庭 jiātíng (family), 其他 (other).

texts.label: 课文1
texts.heading_zh: 孙月和王静聊王静的生活情况
texts.heading_en: Sun Yue and Wang Jing chat about Wang Jing's life

lines.speaker: 孙月
lines.zh: 礼拜天有空儿吗？陪我去逛街怎么样？我想去给丈夫买个生日礼物。
lines.pinyin: Lǐbàitiān yǒu kòngr ma? Péi wǒ qù guàng jiē zěnmeyàng? Wǒ xiǎng qù gěi zhàngfu mǎi ge shēngrì lǐwù.
lines.en: Are you free on Sunday? How about coming shopping with me? I want to buy a birthday present for my husband.

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 我可能去不了，最近事情多。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kěnéng qù bu liǎo, zuìjìn shìqing duō.
lines.en: I probably can't make it — I've had a lot going on lately.

lines.speaker: 孙月
lines.zh: 你最近是不是工作特别忙？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn shì bu shì gōngzuò tèbié máng?
lines.en: Have you been especially busy with work lately?

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 我现在上有老，下有小。除了工作以外，家里还有母亲和儿子需要照顾。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài shàng yǒu lǎo, xià yǒu xiǎo. Chúle gōngzuò yǐwài, jiā li hái yǒu mǔqīn hé érzi xūyào zhàogù.
lines.en: I have elderly parents to look after and a young child to raise. Besides work, I also need to take care of my mother and son at home.

lines.speaker: 孙月
lines.zh: 真是辛苦啊！你最近脸色不太好，是不是哪儿不舒服？要注意身体啊。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn shì xīnkǔ a! Nǐ zuìjìn liǎnsè bú tài hǎo, shì bu shì nǎr bù shūfu? Yào zhùyì shēntǐ a.
lines.en: That must be exhausting! You haven't looked well lately — do you feel unwell somewhere? You should take care of your health.

lines.speaker: 王静
lines.zh: 没事儿，谢谢！不过现在我很幸福，因为在母亲面前我可以做一个永远长不大的孩子；在孩子面前我又是个能照顾他的母亲，这让我有了努力的方向。
lines.pinyin: Méi shìr, xièxie! Búguò xiànzài wǒ hěn xìngfú, yīnwèi zài mǔqīn miànqián wǒ kěyǐ zuò yí ge yǒngyuǎn zhǎng bu dà de háizi; zài háizi miànqián wǒ yòu shì ge néng zhàogù tā de mǔqīn, zhè ràng wǒ yǒule nǔlì de fāngxiàng.
lines.en: I'm fine, thanks! But actually I'm very happy now, because in front of my mother I get to be a child who never has to grow up, and in front of my child I'm a mother who can take care of him — that gives me a direction to work toward.

texts.label: 课文2
texts.heading_zh: 高老师和李老师在谈幸福
texts.heading_en: Teacher Gao and Teacher Li talk about happiness

lines.speaker: 高老师
lines.zh: 你看人家王老师，刚来这儿工作三年就当了教授，还有个好妻子，真让人羡慕！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn rénjia Wáng lǎoshī, gāng lái zhèr gōngzuò sān nián jiù dāngle jiàoshòu, hái yǒu ge hǎo qīzi, zhēn ràng rén xiànmù!
lines.en: Look at Teacher Wang — he's only been working here three years and he's already a professor, and he has a great wife too. It really makes people envious!

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.zh: 其实，你在别人眼中也是很幸福的，只是你自己没有发现。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí, nǐ zài biérén yǎn zhōng yě shì hěn xìngfú de, zhǐshì nǐ zìjǐ méi yǒu fāxiàn.
lines.en: Actually, in other people's eyes you're quite happy too — you just haven't noticed it yourself.

lines.speaker: 高老师
lines.zh: 是吗？我哪能跟王老师比啊？
lines.pinyin: Shì ma? Wǒ nǎ néng gēn Wáng lǎoshī bǐ a?
lines.en: Really? How could I possibly compare with Teacher Wang?

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.zh: 你有一个漂亮的女儿，还那么优秀，硕士毕业后就当了翻译。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu yí ge piàoliang de nǚ'ér, hái nàme yōuxiù, shuòshì bìyè hòu jiù dāngle fānyì.
lines.en: You have a beautiful daughter who's so outstanding too — right after getting her master's degree she became a translator.

lines.speaker: 高老师
lines.zh: 我女儿确实不错，记得她刚拿到第一个月工资时，就兴奋地拉着我和她爸俩去商场，给我们买礼物，那时我和她爸心里别提多美了！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér quèshí búcuò, jìde tā gāng nádào dì yī ge yuè gōngzī shí, jiù xīngfèn de lāzhe wǒ hé tā bà liǎ qù shāngchǎng, gěi wǒmen mǎi lǐwù, nà shí wǒ hé tā bà xīn li biétí duō měi le!
lines.en: My daughter really is great. I remember when she got her first month's salary, she excitedly dragged her father and me to the mall and bought us presents — her dad and I were happier than words could say!

lines.speaker: 李老师
lines.zh: 所以说每个人有每个人的生活，不用羡慕别人。你羡慕别人的时候，他们可能也正在羡慕你呢。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ shuō měi ge rén yǒu měi ge rén de shēnghuó, bú yòng xiànmù biérén. Nǐ xiànmù biérén de shíhou, tāmen kěnéng yě zhèngzài xiànmù nǐ ne.
lines.en: So you see, everyone has their own life — there's no need to envy others. While you're envying someone else, they might be envying you too.

texts.label: 课文3
texts.heading_zh: 小雨和小夏聊找工作的事情
texts.heading_en: Xiaoyu and Xiaoxia chat about finding a job

lines.speaker: 小雨
lines.zh: 时间过得真快，马上就要毕业了。毕业后你打算做什么？
lines.pinyin: Shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài, mǎshàng jiù yào bìyè le. Bìyè hòu nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
lines.en: Time really flies — we're about to graduate. What do you plan to do after graduation?

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 我还没想好呢，正想听听你的建议。你觉得在选择职业时，收入重要吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo ne, zhèng xiǎng tīngting nǐ de jiànyì. Nǐ juéde zài xuǎnzé zhíyè shí, shōurù zhòngyào ma?
lines.en: I haven't decided yet — I was just about to ask for your advice. Do you think income matters when choosing a career?

lines.speaker: 小雨
lines.zh: 在我看来，赚钱多少不是最重要的，兴趣才是关键。只有做自己喜欢的事，才会觉得幸福，将来也会有更好的发展。
lines.pinyin: Zài wǒ kànlái, zhuàn qián duō shǎo bú shì zuì zhòngyào de, xìngqù cái shì guānjiàn. Zhǐyǒu zuò zìjǐ xǐhuan de shì, cái huì juéde xìngfú, jiānglái yě huì yǒu gèng hǎo de fāzhǎn.
lines.en: In my opinion, how much money you make isn't the most important thing — interest is the key. Only by doing what you love will you feel happy, and you'll also have better prospects in the future.

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 我也这么想。如果我带着热情去做自己喜欢的工作，就不会感到累。不过，现在什么东西都那么贵，生活压力太大了，没有钱也不会过得幸福啊！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème xiǎng. Rúguǒ wǒ dàizhe rèqíng qù zuò zìjǐ xǐhuan de gōngzuò, jiù bú huì gǎndào lèi. Búguò, xiànzài shénme dōngxi dōu nàme guì, shēnghuó yālì tài dà le, méiyǒu qián yě bú huì guò de xìngfú a!
lines.en: I think so too. If I put my heart into doing work I love, I won't feel tired. But everything is so expensive nowadays, and the pressure of life is too great — without money, life won't be happy either!

lines.speaker: 小雨
lines.zh: 幸福其实很简单，它不是只要有钱就能买到的。我觉得工作结束回家后，洗个热水澡，然后躺在床上看看书、听听音乐，困了睡睡觉，就很幸福。
lines.pinyin: Xìngfú qíshí hěn jiǎndān, tā bú shì zhǐyào yǒu qián jiù néng mǎidào de. Wǒ juéde gōngzuò jiéshù huí jiā hòu, xǐ ge rè shuǐzǎo, ránhòu tǎng zài chuáng shang kànkan shū, tīngting yīnyuè, kùnle shuìshui jiào, jiù hěn xìngfú.
lines.en: Happiness is actually very simple — it's not something you can just buy with money. I think that after finishing work and going home, taking a hot shower, then lying in bed reading a little, listening to some music, and sleeping when I'm tired — that's happiness.

lines.speaker: 小夏
lines.zh: 你说的也对。如果能找到一份自己既感兴趣，收入又不错的工作，那就最好了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de yě duì. Rúguǒ néng zhǎodào yí fèn zìjǐ jì gǎn xìngqù, shōurù yòu búcuò de gōngzuò, nà jiù zuì hǎo le.
lines.en: You're right too. If I could find a job that I'm both interested in and that pays well, that would be best.

lines.zh: 有的人希望穿得再好一些，房子再大一些，认为经济条件越好人就越幸福。
lines.pinyin: Yǒude rén xīwàng chuān de zài hǎo yìxiē, fángzi zài dà yìxiē, rènwéi jīngjì tiáojiàn yuè hǎo rén jiù yuè xìngfú.
lines.en: Some people hope to dress a bit better and have a bigger house, believing that the better one's economic conditions, the happier one will be.

lines.zh: 其实有很多富人过得并不愉快，而有些穷人却过得很快乐。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí yǒu hěn duō fù rén guò de bìng bù yúkuài, ér yǒuxiē qióng rén què guò de hěn kuàilè.
lines.en: In fact many rich people are not happy at all, while some poor people live quite happily.

lines.zh: 有钱不一定幸福，因为很多东西都是不能用钱买到的，例如时间、感情、生活经历等。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu qián bù yídìng xìngfú, yīnwèi hěn duō dōngxi dōu shì bù néng yòng qián mǎidào de, lìrú shíjiān, gǎnqíng, shēnghuó jīnglì děng.
lines.en: Having money doesn't necessarily mean happiness, because many things cannot be bought with money — for example, time, feelings, and life experience.

lines.zh: 但是，从另外一个方面看，如果没钱，也很难过得幸福。
lines.pinyin: Dànshì, cóng lìngwài yí ge fāngmiàn kàn, rúguǒ méi qián, yě hěn nán guò de xìngfú.
lines.en: But looking at it from another angle, if you have no money, it's also hard to live happily.

lines.zh: 当你生病了，如果由于缺钱而不能及时去看医生，你的健康都很难得到保证，就更别说幸福了。
lines.pinyin: Dāng nǐ shēng bìng le, rúguǒ yóuyú quē qián ér bù néng jíshí qù kàn yīshēng, nǐ de jiànkāng dōu hěn nán dédào bǎozhèng, jiù gèng biéshuō xìngfú le.
lines.en: When you fall ill, if you cannot see a doctor in time for lack of money, your health can hardly be guaranteed, let alone your happiness.

lines.zh: 什么是幸福？
lines.pinyin: Shénme shì xìngfú?
lines.en: What is happiness?

lines.zh: 有的人认为，工资高、能赚钱就是幸福；有的人认为，心情放松、身体健康才是幸福；也有人认为，能帮助别人就是一种幸福。
lines.pinyin: Yǒude rén rènwéi, gōngzī gāo, néng zhuàn qián jiù shì xìngfú; yǒude rén rènwéi, xīnqíng fàngsōng, shēntǐ jiànkāng cái shì xìngfú; yě yǒu rén rènwéi, néng bāngzhù biérén jiù shì yì zhǒng xìngfú.
lines.en: Some people think a high salary and the ability to earn money is happiness; some think a relaxed mood and good health are true happiness; others think being able to help other people is a kind of happiness.

lines.zh: 还有人说，小时候幸福是一件东西，比如一块橡皮、一块糖，得到了就很幸福；长大后幸福是一种态度，生活的态度决定了我们幸福感的高低。
lines.pinyin: Hái yǒu rén shuō, xiǎo shíhou xìngfú shì yí jiàn dōngxi, bǐrú yí kuài xiàngpí, yí kuài táng, dédàole jiù hěn xìngfú; zhǎngdà hòu xìngfú shì yì zhǒng tàidù, shēnghuó de tàidù juédìngle wǒmen xìngfúgǎn de gāodī.
lines.en: Others say that in childhood happiness is a thing — for example an eraser or a piece of candy — and getting it makes you very happy; after growing up happiness is an attitude, and one's attitude toward life determines how high or low our sense of happiness is.

lines.zh: 那怎样才算是真正的幸福？
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnyàng cái suàn shì zhēnzhèng de xìngfú?
lines.en: So what really counts as true happiness?

lines.zh: 其实，幸福并没有一个标准答案，每个人对幸福都有不同的理解。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí, xìngfú bìng méiyǒu yí ge biāozhǔn dá'àn, měi ge rén duì xìngfú dōu yǒu bù tóng de lǐjiě.
lines.en: In fact, happiness has no standard answer; every person has a different understanding of happiness.

lines.zh: 不管你认为幸福是什么，只要你用心去找，就一定能发现它。
lines.pinyin: Bùguǎn nǐ rènwéi xìngfú shì shénme, zhǐyào nǐ yòng xīn qù zhǎo, jiù yídìng néng fāxiàn tā.
lines.en: No matter what you think happiness is, as long as you search for it with your heart, you will surely find it.

vocab.en: Master, person who has a master's degree

grammar.point: 不过 (as a conjunction of transition, and as an adverb meaning 'only')
grammar.explanation: As a conjunction, '不过' is used at the beginning of the second clause to indicate a transition in meaning, supplementing or revising what was said in the first clause. As an adverb, '不过' means 'merely/only', emphasizing that an amount or scale is small.

examples.zh: 我现在上有老，下有小。除了工作以外，家里还有母亲和儿子需要照顾。不过现在我很幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài shàng yǒu lǎo, xià yǒu xiǎo. Chúle gōngzuò yǐwài, jiā li hái yǒu mǔqīn hé érzi xūyào zhàogù. Búguò xiànzài wǒ hěn xìngfú.
examples.en: I have elderly parents to look after and a young child to raise. Besides work, I also need to take care of my mother and son at home. But I'm very happy now.

examples.zh: 你再早来一会儿就好了，那辆车刚开走，你只能等下一辆了。不过也不用多长时间，估计十几分钟就来了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài zǎo lái yíhuìr jiù hǎo le, nà liàng chē gāng kāi zǒu, nǐ zhǐ néng děng xià yí liàng le. Búguò yě bú yòng duō cháng shíjiān, gūjì shí jǐ fēnzhōng jiù lái le.
examples.en: It would have been better if you'd come a bit earlier — that vehicle just left, so you'll have to wait for the next one. But it won't take very long; it should come in about ten-odd minutes.

examples.zh: 我们不过谈了点儿工作方面的问题，别的都没谈。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen búguò tán le diǎnr gōngzuò fāngmiàn de wèntí, biéde dōu méi tán.
examples.en: We only talked a little about work-related matters; we didn't discuss anything else.

examples.zh: A：没有你的帮助，我们肯定不能按时完成任务，真是太谢谢你了。 B：你太客气了，我不过是给了些建议，这一切都是你们辛苦努力的结果。
examples.pinyin: A: Méiyǒu nǐ de bāngzhù, wǒmen kěndìng bù néng ànshí wánchéng rènwu, zhēn shì tài xièxie nǐ le. B: Nǐ tài kèqi le, wǒ búguò shì gěile xiē jiànyì, zhè yíqiè dōu shì nǐmen xīnkǔ nǔlì de jiéguǒ.
examples.en: A: "Without your help, we definitely couldn't have finished the task on time. Thank you so much." B: "You're too polite. I only gave a few suggestions — all of this is the result of your hard work."

grammar.explanation: '确实' is an adverb that confirms the veracity/truthfulness of an objective situation (indeed, truly, really).

examples.zh: 爱情确实是结婚的重要原因，但仅有爱情是不够的。
examples.pinyin: Àiqíng quèshí shì jiéhūn de zhòngyào yuányīn, dàn jǐn yǒu àiqíng shì bú gòu de.
examples.en: Love truly is an important reason for marriage, but love alone is not enough.

examples.zh: A：好几年没见，你还是这么爱开玩笑，我哪儿有你说的那么年轻。 B：我说的是真的，你确实比以前更年轻、更漂亮了。
examples.pinyin: A: Hǎo jǐ nián méi jiàn, nǐ háishi zhème ài kāi wánxiào, wǒ nǎr yǒu nǐ shuō de nàme niánqīng. B: Wǒ shuō de shì zhēn de, nǐ quèshí bǐ yǐqián gèng niánqīng, gèng piàoliang le.
examples.en: A: "Haven't seen you in years — you still love joking around. I'm nowhere near as young as you say." B: "I'm telling the truth, you really are younger and prettier than before."

examples.zh: 我女儿确实不错，记得她刚拿到第一个月工资时，就兴奋地拉着我和她爸俩去商场，给我们买礼物，那时我和她爸心里别提多美了！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér quèshí búcuò, jìde tā gāng nádào dì yī ge yuè gōngzī shí, jiù xīngfèn de lāzhe wǒ hé tā bà liǎ qù shāngchǎng, gěi wǒmen mǎi lǐwù, nà shí wǒ hé tā bà xīn li biétí duō měi le!
examples.en: My daughter really is great. I remember when she got her first month's salary, she excitedly dragged her father and me to the mall and bought us presents — her dad and I were happier than words could say!

grammar.explanation: '在……看来' (in so-and-so's opinion) is a parenthetical expression indicating that what follows is an opinion or viewpoint.

examples.zh: 在很多人看来，听流行音乐仅仅是年轻人的爱好，其实现在不少中老年人对流行歌曲也很感兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Zài hěn duō rén kànlái, tīng liúxíng yīnyuè jǐnjǐn shì niánqīng rén de àihào, qíshí xiànzài bù shǎo zhōng-lǎonián rén duì liúxíng gēqǔ yě hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.en: In many people's view, listening to pop music is merely a young person's hobby; but actually quite a few middle-aged and elderly people are also very interested in pop songs nowadays.

examples.zh: 在我看来，比赛结果并不是最重要的，在参加比赛的过程中使自己获得提高更重要。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ kànlái, bǐsài jiéguǒ bìng bú shì zuì zhòngyào de, zài cānjiā bǐsài de guòchéng zhōng shǐ zìjǐ huòdé tígāo gèng zhòngyào.
examples.en: In my opinion, the outcome of a competition isn't the most important thing — improving yourself through the process of competing matters more.

examples.zh: A：你觉得在选择职业时，收入重要吗？ B：在我看来，赚钱多少不是最重要的，兴趣才是关键。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ juéde zài xuǎnzé zhíyè shí, shōurù zhòngyào ma? B: Zài wǒ kànlái, zhuàn qián duō shǎo bú shì zuì zhòngyào de, xìngqù cái shì guānjiàn.
examples.en: A: "Do you think income matters when choosing a career?" B: "In my opinion, how much you earn isn't the most important thing — interest is the key."

grammar.explanation: As a conjunction, '由于' indicates the reason for something and is followed by a sentence, usually used in the first clause of a complex sentence. It can also be used as a preposition indicating a reason, followed by a nominal phrase.

examples.zh: 今年春节他们本来打算出国去逛逛，但是由于家里的老人突然生病了，所以他们只好放弃了这个计划。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián Chūnjié tāmen běnlái dǎsuàn chūguó qù guàngguang, dànshì yóuyú jiā li de lǎorén tūrán shēng bìng le, suǒyǐ tāmen zhǐhǎo fàngqìle zhège jìhuà.
examples.en: This Spring Festival they had originally planned to travel abroad, but because an elderly family member suddenly fell ill, they had no choice but to give up this plan.

examples.zh: 当你生病了，如果由于缺钱而不能及时去看医生，你的健康都很难得到保证，就更别说幸福了。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ shēng bìng le, rúguǒ yóuyú quē qián ér bù néng jíshí qù kàn yīshēng, nǐ de jiànkāng dōu hěn nán dédào bǎozhèng, jiù gèng biéshuō xìngfú le.
examples.en: When you're sick, if you can't see a doctor in time because you lack money, your health can hardly be guaranteed, let alone happiness.

examples.zh: 由于种种原因，我们不得不改变原来的计划。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú zhǒngzhǒng yuányīn, wǒmen bùdébù gǎibiàn yuánlái de jìhuà.
examples.en: Due to all sorts of reasons, we had no choice but to change our original plan.

examples.zh: 由于工作的需要，我去年十月去了趟上海，跟一家公司去谈生意。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú gōngzuò de xūyào, wǒ qùnián shíyuè qùle tàng Shànghǎi, gēn yì jiā gōngsī qù tán shēngyi.
examples.en: Due to work requirements, I went to Shanghai this past October to discuss business with a company.

grammar.explanation: '比如' is a verb that introduces examples to explain something or some situation (for example, such as).

examples.zh: 还有人说，小时候幸福是一件东西，比如一块橡皮、一块糖，得到了就很幸福。
examples.pinyin: Hái yǒu rén shuō, xiǎo shíhou xìngfú shì yí jiàn dōngxi, bǐrú yí kuài xiàngpí, yí kuài táng, dédàole jiù hěn xìngfú.
examples.en: Others say that in childhood happiness is a thing — for example, an eraser or a piece of candy — and getting it makes you very happy.

examples.zh: 每个人都有自己特别感兴趣的东西，比如，作家爱写小说，画家爱画画儿。我们只有了解了自己的兴趣爱好后，才能更好地发展自己。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ tèbié gǎn xìngqù de dōngxi, bǐrú, zuòjiā ài xiě xiǎoshuō, huàjiā ài huà huàr. Wǒmen zhǐyǒu liǎojiěle zìjǐ de xìngqù àihào hòu, cái néng gèng hǎo de fāzhǎn zìjǐ.
examples.en: Everyone has things they're especially interested in — for example, writers love writing novels, and painters love painting. Only after understanding our own interests and hobbies can we develop ourselves better.

examples.zh: 旅游前最好做个计划，比如要去几个地方，怎么坐车，带哪些东西，一共要玩儿多少天等。把这些都提前想好，旅游时才会更轻松。
examples.pinyin: Lǚyóu qián zuìhǎo zuò ge jìhuà, bǐrú yào qù jǐ ge dìfang, zěnme zuò chē, dài nǎxiē dōngxi, yígòng yào wánr duōshao tiān děng. Bǎ zhèxiē dōu tíqián xiǎnghǎo, lǚyóu shí cái huì gèng qīngsōng.
examples.en: Before traveling it's best to make a plan — for example, how many places to go, how to travel, what things to bring, and how many days in total, etc. Thinking all this through in advance will make the trip more relaxing.

compare.note: 相同点 Similarity: Both '不过' and '但是' can indicate a transition in meaning at the start of the second clause, e.g. 我本来想当律师，不过/但是后来我发现自己对新闻更感兴趣 (Wǒ běnlái xiǎng dāng lǜshī, búguò/dànshì hòulái wǒ fāxiàn zìjǐ duì xīnwén gèng gǎn xìngqù — 'I originally wanted to be a lawyer, but later I found I was more interested in journalism.'). 不同点 Differences: (1) In this transitional sense, '不过' is often used in spoken Chinese to politely give a suggestion or express refusal, while '但是' conveys a harder/stronger tone of transition. E.g. 对不起，先生，那种蛋糕已经卖完了，不过，您可以尝一下这种饼干，味道也很不错 (Duìbuqǐ, xiānsheng, nà zhǒng dàngāo yǐjīng mài wán le, búguò, nín kěyǐ cháng yíxià zhè zhǒng bǐnggān, wèidao yě hěn búcuò — 'Sorry sir, that cake is sold out, but you could try this cookie, it tastes great too.'); 别人的方法也许很有效，但是并不一定适合你 (Biérén de fāngfǎ yěxǔ hěn yǒuxiào, dànshì bìng bù yídìng shìhé nǐ — 'Other people's methods might be quite effective, but they won't necessarily suit you.'). (2) '不过' can also function as an adverb meaning 'only, merely', usually followed by a numeral; '但是' has no such usage. E.g. 去年我不过50公斤，今年怎么这么胖了？(Qùnián wǒ búguò wǔshí gōngjīn, jīnnián zěnme zhème pàng le? — 'Last year I was only 50 kg — how did I get so fat this year?')

examples.zh: 每个人在工作、学习、经济上都或多或少会有压力。有压力不一定是坏事，关键是要知道怎样做才能给自己减压。看电影、听音乐，还有跟朋友一起聊天儿、散步等，都是非常有效的办法。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén zài gōngzuò, xuéxí, jīngjì shàng dōu huòduōhuòshǎo huì yǒu yālì. Yǒu yālì bù yídìng shì huàishì, guānjiàn shì yào zhīdào zěnyàng zuò cái néng gěi zìjǐ jiǎn yā. Kàn diànyǐng, tīng yīnyuè, hái yǒu gēn péngyou yìqǐ liáotiānr, sànbù děng, dōu shì fēicháng yǒuxiào de bànfǎ.
examples.en: Everyone experiences some degree of pressure in work, study, and finances. Having pressure isn't necessarily a bad thing — the key is knowing how to relieve your own stress. Watching movies, listening to music, chatting and taking walks with friends are all very effective methods.

examples.zh: 有家广告公司正在招聘高级经理，要求是艺术专业毕业，有两年以上工作经验。我觉得你的条件挺合适的，可以去试试。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu jiā guǎnggào gōngsī zhèngzài zhāopìn gāojí jīnglǐ, yāoqiú shì yìshù zhuānyè bìyè, yǒu liǎng nián yǐshàng gōngzuò jīngyàn. Wǒ juéde nǐ de tiáojiàn tǐng héshì de, kěyǐ qù shìshi.
examples.en: An advertising company is recruiting a senior manager, requiring an arts-related degree and over two years of work experience. I think your qualifications fit well — you should give it a try.

examples.zh: 人一生中会遇到很多事情，或者愉快，或者伤心，都只能由自己去经历。生活是自己在过，别人说什么不重要，自己感觉快乐就行了。
examples.pinyin: Rén yìshēng zhōng huì yùdào hěn duō shìqing, huòzhě yúkuài, huòzhě shāngxīn, dōu zhǐ néng yóu zìjǐ qù jīnglì. Shēnghuó shì zìjǐ zài guò, biérén shuō shénme bú zhòngyào, zìjǐ gǎnjué kuàilè jiù xíng le.
examples.en: In one's life you'll encounter many things, happy or sad, and you can only go through them yourself. You're the one living your life — it doesn't matter what others say, as long as you feel happy yourself.

culture.summary: 中国有个成语叫“知足常乐”。简单地说就是知道满足，才会快乐。人生的最高境界是心情愉快，金钱并不是唯一追求的目标，还有其他更重要的东西。比如，你有一个健康的身体、一个知心的爱人、一个温暖幸福的家庭、一份自己喜爱的工作，这些都不是用金钱能买到的。知足常乐，可以使你的生活每天都阳光灿烂，春暖花开。 EN: The Chinese idiom "知足常乐 (Contentment is happiness)" means in simple words that to be happy you need to be content with what you have. The highest realm of life is maintaining a happy mood. Money is not the only goal to be sought after; there are many other important things in life, such as good health, an understanding lover, a warm, happy family, and a desirable job, none of which can be bought with money. To be content with what you have will make each and every day of your life full of sunshine and pleasantness.

exercises: 注释1 不过 — 练一练 Complete the sentences/dialogues with 不过: (1) 这么漂亮的衣服____，买一件吧。(不过) (2) A：中午吃西红柿鸡蛋面怎么样？ B：可以，____。(不过) (3) A：你知道怎么去世界公园吗？我明天要去那儿附近办点儿事。 B：我对那儿也不太熟悉，____。(不过)

比一比 不过/但是 — 做一做 Tick or cross table (选词填空，choose 不过 and/or 但是 for each blank): (1) 每天喝一点儿葡萄酒，对身体是有好处的。____不能喝太多。 [answer key shown: 不过✓ 但是✓] (2) 他结婚的时候____20岁。 [answer key shown: 不过✓ 但是✗] (3) 大部分人每天晚上至少应该睡7个小时，____这个标准并不适合每一个人。 [no answer marks printed — left for the student] (4) 对不起，先生，我们店的刷卡机坏了，只能用现金。____商场附近有家银行，您出了门右转，走到头儿就能看到。 [no answer marks printed] (5) 这次亲戚来北京____住两三天，就让他来家里住吧，不用住宾馆了。 [no answer marks printed]

注释2 确实 — 练一练 Complete the dialogues/sentences with 确实: (1) A：终于爬上来了，累死我了，这山太高了！ B：____。(确实) (2) A：教室里太热了，把窗户打开吧。 B：____。(确实) (3) 有一句歌词是这样写的：“我能想到最浪漫的事，就是和你一起慢慢变老。”世界那么大，两个人相识已经不容易，还要互相了解、互相喜欢，一起生活，一直到生命的最后，____。(确实)

注释3 在……看来 — 练一练 Complete the sentences/dialogues with 在……看来: (1) 有人说时间就是金钱，____。(在……看来) (2) 邓亚萍 (Dèng Yàpíng, a famous Chinese table tennis player) 是中国的乒乓球运动员，她的身高只有一米五五，____。(在……看来) (3) A：你觉得男人和女人在性格上有什么区别？ B：____。(在……看来)
根据课文内容回答问题 (Answer questions based on texts 1-3): 课文1：①孙月让王静陪她去做什么？王静为什么去不了？ ②王静为什么很辛苦？她为什么也觉得很幸福？ 课文2：③高老师为什么羡慕王老师？ ④为什么说高老师在别人眼中也是很幸福的？ 课文3：⑤小雨对选择职业有什么建议？ ⑥在小雨看来，什么是幸福？小夏呢？

注释5 比如 — 练一练 Complete the sentences with 比如: (1) 有时候，质量很好的东西也会很便宜。____。(比如) (2) 刚到一个新环境，有很多种方法来使自己快一点儿适应。____。(比如) (3) 在汉语里，我们把“海”、“江”、“河”这些字左边的部分叫作“三点水”。如果一个字中有这个部分，说明这个字的意思可能和水有关系。这样的汉字还有很多，____。(比如)
根据课文内容回答问题 (Answer questions based on texts 4-5): 课文4：①为什么说有钱不一定幸福？哪些东西是不能用钱买到的？ ②为什么说没钱也很难过得幸福？ 课文5：③关于幸福，人们有哪些不同的看法？ ④怎样才算是真正的幸福？
练习1 复述 Retell the dialogues, staying in character: 课文1 王静的语气：孙月让我礼拜天陪她去逛街，…… 课文2 李老师的语气：王老师刚来这儿工作三年就当了教授，…… 课文3 小雨的语气：在选择职业时，将来的发展比收入更重要，……

练习2 选择合适的词语填空 Choose the proper words to fill in the blanks — set 1, word bank 低/困/拉/永远/建议: ①一个不知道自己缺点的人，____都不会想要去改变。 ②他们两个人打球的水平差不多，很难分出高____。 ③我刚学会开车，水平一般，还经常走错路。朋友____我平时多开车出去走走，熟悉一下道路情况，这样慢慢就好了。 ④解决问题时，一个人的知识常常是不够的，所以人与人之间需要交流。在交流过程中，一方面，丰富了知识，提高了能力，另一方面，又____近了人们之间的距离。 ⑤人比动物聪明，但动物仍然有很多值得人学习的地方。拿狮子来说，它们____的时候才睡觉，饿的时候才吃东西，永远不为昨天的事烦恼，也不为明天的事担心。

练习2 选择合适的词语填空 — set 2, word bank 空儿/答案/礼拜天/关键/躺: ⑥A：你最近忙吗？哪天有____？ B：干什么？又想让我陪你去逛街呀？ ⑦A：____我们去学校的体育馆打网球吧？ B：好啊，不过周末人会不会很多？ ⑧A：房间里这么暗，怎么不开灯呀？你身体不舒服？ B：没有，我本来____在沙发上看书，结果睡着了。 ⑨A：很多女孩子都希望找一个个子高的男朋友，你呢？ B：高矮没太大关系，____是我得喜欢他、爱他。 ⑩A：怎么了？什么事这么不高兴？ B：别提了，今天考试写____写到最后，发现少了一个，又来不及改了。

扩展 同字词 经 — 做一做 Fill in the blanks with 经济/经验/经历: ①取得成功的人都____过许多失败，他们和普通人的区别是，他们坚持了下来，正是这种坚持，使他们从失败走向了成功。 ②我哥哥今年26岁，现在正在读硕士研究生，学的是____法专业。我觉得他不但能力强，而且脾气好，将来一定能找到一份很好的工作。 ③我们长大的过程，就是解决一个又一个问题，在失败中慢慢积累____，在成功中慢慢获得信心的过程。
运用1 双人活动 Pair Work — 互相了解对方关于幸福的看法，完成调查表 (learn about each other's opinions on happiness): 1 对你来说，幸福的标准是什么？ 2 你认为怎样才能获得幸福？ 3 你羡慕谁？羡慕他/她什么？ 4 你什么时候会感到幸福？ 5 猜猜“身在福中不知福”是什么意思。
运用2 小组活动 Group Work — 幸福是一种感觉，每个人对幸福都有不同的理解。向小组成员介绍一个你认为幸福的人或者一件让你感到幸福的事（请最少用四个下面的结构）：a. 上有老，下有小 b. 努力的方向 c. 真让人羡慕 d. 确实不错 e. 在我看来 f. 其实很简单 g. 有钱不一定幸福 h. 并没有一个标准答案
